Name_52.ru: Сфера Ци из трех простых чисел

Name_133.ru: Гребень с тонкими зубьями богини Ло

Name_175.ru: Бусина из Нефрита цвета слоновой кости

Desc_0.en: A Damascus Steel ring that can sometimes unexpectedly pierce the enemy's skin and make them bleed when attacking.
Desc_0.cn: 镔铁所打造的指环，戴于指上，偶尔于攻击时，可以其坚硬，于无形处刮破他人皮肉，使人流血受伤。
Desc_0.ru: Кольцо из дамасской стали, которое иногда может неожиданно проткнуть кожу врага и вызвать у него кровотечение при атаке.

Desc_1.en: Completely forged from steel, the abacus is black and smooth with symbols on the beads often used for divination. A secret apparatus in this particular abacus sends the beads flying to injure the enemy when activated.
Desc_1.cn: 算盘通体由钢打造，漆黑油亮，盘上算珠标有符记，常可用于占卦问天。此盘藏有机括，算珠可脱盘飞出，时而伤人。
Desc_1.ru: Полностью выкованные из стали, счеты черные и гладкие, с символами на бусинах, которые часто используются для гадания. Секретное устройство в этих конкретных счетах при активации отправляет бусинки в полет, чтобы ранить врага.

Desc_2.en: The Graywolf Chain is a long chain with sharp spikes is often tied to a weapon through a gauntlet to make it even more powerful. It is difficult to approach anyone waving the chain, and those nearby may be impaled by the spikes.
Desc_2.cn: 孤狼镣乃为一件带刺长镣，常通过护手绑持在武器之上，以增加其威力。见此器挥舞者，或难以近之，或近之而易为尖刺所伤。
Desc_2.ru: Цепь Серого волка - это длинная цепь с острыми шипами, которую часто привязывают к Оружию через перчатку, чтобы сделать его еще более мощным. Трудно приблизиться к тому, кто размахивает цепью, и те, кто находится поблизости, могут быть пронзены шипами.

Desc_3.en: Among the generals of Shu, Zhang Fei boasts the greatest courage and might. Zhang Fei Bone, the giant and firm metal weapon, is shaped like a curved bone, and when waved around, it moves even the heaviest item in its way with an intimidating and indomitable force.
Desc_3.cn: “蜀之诸将，惟飞最雄”，张飞骨乃金铁所造，形如弯骨而巨大，质地极坚，动则势带雄风，可掀重物。于人腾挪转移之间，声势破空，扰人骇人。

Desc_4.en: The Ghost-Commanding Tiger Seal takes the form of a crouching tiger, with the tiger's body adorned in gold inscribed with cryptic symbols. Legend has it that this artifact commands spirits to dispel other spirits, carrying with it killing intent. Carried at one's side, it emboldens individuals, instilling them with courage and martial prowess. They often seem to have the unseen aid of spirits, and their strikes sometimes leave behind additional trails of blood.
Desc_4.cn: 鬼令虎符形似卧虎，虎身以金嵌入阴文，传闻此物可令鬼驱鬼，自带威风煞气。此物携于身侧，人因之胆壮勇武，常似有无形之鬼相助，攻人之势有时亦将多出几道血痕。

Desc_5.en: The Biographies of the Deities and Immortals from the Jin dynasty reads, "Those who excel in the mastery of the Wood Terms in the sexagenary cycle may command deities and ghosts and produce food from thin air." The Hexus Mirror that records the way of Wood terms in the sexagenary cycle, and it is said that those who comprehend the way may change with flexibility and agility when practicing their skills, so their movements cannot be predicted.
Desc_5.cn: 晋时《神仙传》：“尤明六甲，能役使鬼神，坐致行厨”，传言通六甲者，可通变化之术。六甲玄鉴乃是一方记录六甲之术的明镜，若能参透此宝其中奥义，便常于运功时有机变灵通之举，而他人莫能预知其行止。

Desc_6.en: Ride the Chi Loong on northern expeditions. Chi Loong, often mistaken for a tiger, has the head and claws of a tiger and symbolizes power and might. The throne is carved with the Chi Loong which represents the bravery and might of the deities to bless one with indomitable strength.
Desc_6.cn: “驾玄螭兮北征”，螭虎，乃螭龙，因其头爪类走兽而讹称为虎，素来为权势、神武之证。须弥座上雕螭虎，乃借神佛之勇武、刚强，得一时勇往无前之气魄而威风凛凛。

Desc_7.en: Absorbs the essence of life and exudes great Yang energy. The Solar Firebead contains extreme Yang energy as though scorched in a divine fire. Those who hold them may feel their hands burn and their body surrounded by an extreme Yang aura with each breath they take, and their strikes are capable of burning the enemy as if standing among flames.
Desc_7.cn: “咀嚼英华，呼吸太阳”，太阳真火本乃帝俊所出，太阳真火珠中蕴藏极大之阳气，犹如受神火炙烤，此珠捧于手中，则手觉炽热，呼吸吐纳间不自觉周身已被极阳之气包裹，因而但凡出手，犹带烈火，其炽触而伤人。

Desc_8.en: Forged from Aerosiderite, the ring is in the shape of a sinister Loong with its head beneath its tail, symbolizing the power to dictate life and death. Those who wear it feel powerful enough to slay Loongs, inflicting severe injuries as if clawed by a ferocious Loong.
Desc_8.cn: 玄铁铸成指环，塑降龙形于其上，其形狞恶，龙头在尾下，主生人杀人之权。玄铁引得降龙之气，佩戴者如获生杀之力，但闻破空声阵阵，所划出伤势均有如恶龙所伤，势狰狞而难治。

Desc_9.en: Cast from meta copper, the Meta Copper Bead contains another structure inside and rings clearly when shaken. One may wear it when practicing martial arts to see whether their stance is rigid from the waist down.
Desc_9.cn: 以元铜浇筑而成的圆珠，内有机巧，摇晃时会发出清脆的响声，习武时将元铜珠佩戴在身上，可以查验下盘是否稳定。
Desc_9.ru: Отлитый из меди meta, шарик Meta Copper содержит внутри другую структуру и отчетливо звенит при встряхивании. Человек может носить его, когда занимается Боевыми искусствами, чтобы посмотреть, является ли его Стойка жесткой ниже пояса.

Desc_10.en: Made of silver, the nine-cun-long brush is light and flexible despite its heavy and clumsy appearance, easily wielded even by those without any Qi strength. The wielder will appear calm and composed like a respected judge.
Desc_10.cn: 银制的判官笔，长七寸有余，似重实轻，似拙实巧，毫无内力之人也可以运用自如，持者气定神闲，举止泰然，好似有判官风度。
Desc_10.ru: Изготовленная из серебра кисть длиной в девять цуней легкая и гибкая, несмотря на свой тяжелый и неуклюжий внешний вид, ею легко пользоваться даже тем, у кого нет Силы Ци. Владелец будет выглядеть спокойным и собранным, как уважаемый судья.

Desc_11.en: Toad Figure is carefully crafted in the unique shape of a toad with its head looking up, and the small structures inside its four feet help the toad stand firmly on ice or sand.
Desc_11.cn: 朝天蛤蟆乃是一尊仰面朝天的蟾蜍摆件，造型别致，制作精妙，其四足嵌有微小的机关，可以使蟾蜍稳固的立于冰面、泥沙等地，颇为神奇巧妙。
Desc_11.ru: Фигурка жабы тщательно выполнена в уникальной форме жабы с поднятой головой, а небольшие конструкции внутри ее четырех лап помогают жабе твердо стоять на льду или песке.

Desc_12.en: The horizon brightened in the morning; the Mt. Chicheng aglow. Spreading is the sunshine, shining on the snowy slope. The small and delicate Sunglow Orb is known for the rosy sheen around it that resembles the sun shining. When placed still, it emits a brilliant and dazzling light that enchants those who gaze upon it.
Desc_12.cn: “四明三千里，朝起赤城霞。日出红光散，分辉照雪崖”。赤霞珠小巧玲珑，因通身光色犹如赤红的云霞而得名，将之静置时，则霞光流散，绮丽缤纷。

Desc_13.en: Cast from smelted gold, the Monarch Seal is tough and heavy with an aureate shine, and due to the complex production method, it is extremely expensive and exclusively used by kings and monarchs in previous dynasties.
Desc_13.cn: 将金器熔解之后铸成的金印。铄金印通体金光灿烂，质地坚硬沉重，因铸造时的工艺繁琐复杂，故而价格十分高昂，在古时唯有王侯将相方能掌执使用。
Desc_13.ru: Печать монарха, отлитая из расплавленного золота, прочная и тяжелая, с золотистым блеском, а из-за сложного способа изготовления она чрезвычайно дорога и использовалась исключительно королями и монархинями предыдущих династий.

Desc_14.en: Cast from rare copper and iron, the Spirit Treasure Ding will remain pristine without a spot of rust even years later. It is carved with the four divine spirits - the Azure Loong, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermilion Bird - to symbolize harmony and peace across the country.
Desc_14.cn: 威灵，即神灵。威灵宝鼎由罕见的铜铁铸成，可经年不朽，光洁如新，其鼎身刻有苍龙、白虎、玄武、朱雀四方神灵，象征“天之四灵，安定四方”。

Desc_15.en: The quaint lamp has a stand made of gold and silver platelets that shine dazzlingly, with an intricate structure that breaks the wind and focuses the light. It is said to be an invention of Ma Jun, a famed craftsman in the Wei and Jin dynasties.
Desc_15.cn: 造型古朴的金银制灯台，灯座部分乃是以金片、银鳞制成，形色灿烂，构造精巧，具有防风凝光之用，可使光影聚而不散、动而不晃，据传乃是魏晋名匠马均创制。
Desc_15.ru: Причудливая лампа имеет подставку из золотых и серебряных пластинок, которые ослепительно сияют, с замысловатой структурой, которая рассеивает ветер и фокусирует свет. Говорят, что это изобретение Ма Цзюня, знаменитого мастера времен династий Вэй и Цзинь.

Desc_16.en: The essence of primordial Yin repulses even the Torch Loong and Xihe, Goddess of the Sun. The clear Luna Firebead is a divine artifact of extreme Yin and coldness, and not even the flames of the Torch Loong or the warmth of Xihe, Goddess of the Sun, may thaw those frozen by the bead.
Desc_16.cn: 所谓“万古太阴精，烛龙所不栖，羲和所不及”，太阴真火珠颜色澄澈，质地阴寒，其所凝冻之物，纵然烛龙衔耀、羲和生光，亦不能化解分毫，堪称神物。

Desc_17.en: Xuan Chi, an ancient deity of the mountains that was the King of Chu's mount during his expedition to the north. Written in golden ink and made of divine iron, the scroll records the origins of the deity, Xuan Chi, and the way to tame it. Hence, legend says that "Seek Xuan Chi with the scroll to ascend above the clouds and sky."
Desc_17.cn: 玄离又称“玄螭”，乃是古之山神，曾为楚王乘驾北征。此册以金水为墨、神铁为书，记载了山神“玄螭”的由来及驭使法门，故世有“玄册寻螭，登天驾云”之说。

Desc_18.en: The Memoir on Neglected Stories reads, "Goujian, King of Yue,offered white bulls to the deities of Kunwu." The white bull is an auspicious symbol that is frequently offered in sacrificial ceremonies going back centuries. The Whitewood Bull made of Chinese Elm is carved in the shape of a bull to repel evil and prevent disasters.
Desc_18.cn: 《拾遗记》：“越王勾践使工人以白牛，祠昆吾之神。”白牛为吉相，自古便常用于祭祀，用白榆木塑白木牛，可驱邪避煞。

Desc_19.en: The eighteen disciples of Shakyamuni Buddha stayed in the world of mortals to spread his teachings and are thus known as the Eighteen Arhats. One may carry the wood figures of the Arhats and chant the Buddhist scriptures to learn that "Signlessness liberates one from the secular world," and slowly ascend beyond the filth of the world and repel all evil.
Desc_19.cn: 释迦佛之十八弟子永驻世间，传法教化，世人感之，称其为十八罗汉。以木雕十八罗汉，常常诵经念佛，常有参悟，“每于垢浊世，见此无相身”，心便可渐渐超脱于垢浊以外，百煞莫侵。

Desc_20.en: The lion, the apex predator that even preys on leopards. The painting is carved on a wooden block in the shape of a lion, the king of all beasts, and lacquered in vermilion. The lion in the Vermilion Lion Painting looks as vivid as if it were coming to life. One may carry it with them to deter weaker insects and poison.
Desc_20.cn: “狮子，亦食虎豹”，狮乃百兽之王，以木刻画狮形，掩以朱漆，画以丹青，成一幅朱漆狮子图。此图栩栩如生，威猛不凡，携于身边，以其威武，可克弱虫邪毒。

Desc_21.en: The Fenghuang Woodfish is exquisitely carved from rosewood. It is hollowed out and produces a melodious sound when hit. It was once called the Auspicious Fish Bell by Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty. "Dedicate to cultivation and be like a fish; keep your eyes open whether day or night." The red color and fish-like shape serve as a constant reminder of trouble and worries, so that one may avoid harm and bad luck.
Desc_21.cn: 凤血木鱼由红木精雕镂空而成，其质中空，敲击有柔和乐音，唐明皇曾称之为瑞鱼磬。“鱼昼夜未尝合目，亦欲修行者昼夜忘寐”，凤血木鱼以其色、相，可警醒世人旦夕莫忘心中事，携带者因之可趋利避害。

Desc_22.en: The Four Heavenly Kings govern the world each with unique abilities to grant wishes, purge trouble, enlighten minds, and cleanse spirits. If one carries the Statue of Heavenly Kings, it will protect them and subdue all demons and monsters nearby.
Desc_22.cn: 天王分理四天下，各有奇宝怒目睁，四宝表法有分教，一求事圆满、二可断烦恼、三能看清楚、四保清净心。若得四天王像在身边，四宝常庇佑，降邪魔伏凶怪。
Desc_22.ru: Миром правят четыре Небесных царя, каждый из которых обладает уникальными способностями исполнять желания, избавлять от неприятностей, просвещать умы и очищать Дух. Если кто-то носит статую Небесных королей, она защитит их и усмирит всех демонов и монстров поблизости.

Desc_23.en: Shijie is liberation from the corpse like a snake shedding its skin or a cicada molting. The Shijie Robe is a miniature wood sculpture that might have been left behind by a Taoist who ascended to immortality. When carried, it has the ability to shield one from dirt, filth, and sinister spirits and lead them onto the correct path.
Desc_23.cn: “尸解者，解形托象，蛇蜕蝉飞”，天香尸解仙带有香气，乃是一件微型木雕道袍，似乎是有人得道尸解成仙而遗落下的。此尸解仙可护持人身，使之不受尘世污浊，不为凶神恶煞所困，引人向道。

Desc_24.en: Bead necklaces vary, and among them agarwood beads are the most precious and may only be worn by eminent monks. Their effects change depending on the direction of the small beads at the end. The beads have a constant, sweet, and rich fragrance, and when worn by a virtuous person, it aids in self-reflection and boosts one's might to eliminate evil from all directions.
Desc_24.cn: 挂珠记戴各不同，以伽楠为贵，通常只有得道高僧可以佩戴，其上弟子珠末端之记子留，朝向亦各有讲求。伽楠挂珠无时不香，香气甘甜浓郁，有德者佩之，可令人时时自省，可增加威仪，力除八方邪气。

Desc_25.en: The Bulwark Bead contains the spiritual energy of the earth and emanates an "aura of moral integrity and tranquil divinity." They may suppress evil, prevent one's spirit from shattering, and save them in life-threatening situations.
Desc_25.cn: 镇元珠含藏地之精气，性可通灵，吹扬“巍巍道德之风”，似传“漠漠神仙之气”。功可驱解四方邪害，于万一时镇得元神不飞去，保一刻性命。
Desc_25.ru: Бусина-оплот содержит духовную Энергию земли и излучает "ауру моральной целостности и спокойной божественности". Они могут подавлять зло, предотвращать разрушение Духа человека и спасать его в опасных для жизни ситуациях.

Desc_26.en: Haotian means immense Primordial Qi. Inspired by the celestial artifact possessed by Jade Emperor, the Haotian Pagoda is carved from wood that, even though inferior to the original artifact, may still gather Primordial Qi between the heaven and earth and nourish one's body and mind, with the power to suppress evil beings underneath for eternity.
Desc_26.cn: “元气昊大，则称昊天”，昊天塔本是昊天上帝所持物，今以奇技塑木塔，虽不及本物神通广大，但也可集天地元气于其中，并以此元气蕴养、护持身心，但逢邪祟，便将其镇于塔下，永不可脱逃。

Desc_27.en: The beauty of a white plum bloom, as breathtaking as the snow. White plum trees bloom in the snow and fear no cold. These Plum Bloom Beads have taken the strength and beauty of white plum blossoms and assist in resisting cold air.
Desc_27.cn: 有道是“梅雪争春未肯降”，白梅生雪中，哪惧朔风寒？此白梅挂珠似得白梅精神，清绝美丽，携于身边也可驱了三分寒意。
Desc_27.ru: Красота цветения белой сливы, такая же захватывающая дух, как и снег. Белые сливовые деревья цветут в снегу и не боятся холода. Эти бусины из цветущей сливы вобрали в себя Силу и красоту белых цветов сливы и помогают противостоять холодному воздуху.

Desc_28.en: The Thaw Beads are made of tempered wood with a natural heat that warms those who wear them and are even capable of thawing nearby ice and snow and repelling cold air.
Desc_28.cn: 冰融为水，谓之冰解。冰解珠乃用木料煣制而成，内含热力，贴身则暖，温而不炽，可使周边冰雪渐化为水，以此解化寒气。
Desc_28.ru: Бусины для оттаивания изготовлены из закаленного дерева с естественным нагревом, которое согревает тех, кто их носит, и даже способно оттаивать близлежащий лед и снег и отталкивать холодный воздух.

Desc_29.en: The Flint Box is made of wood chips and flint that ignite sparks when carried and shaken around, but it doesn't burn due to its specially designed structure. One may catch a glimpse of and feel the flame inside, and when placed over a cold spot, the chill will dissipate immediately as the temperature rises.
Desc_29.cn: 木石为引，攒于盒中，一步一晃，石击成火，木烧而炽，称为火光盒，然因其构造精妙，盒却不燃。人可窥见其中火光，可感其盒中火炽，但有寒凉处，以盒置其上，寒冷便顷刻化解而去，于是周身皆热。

Desc_30.en: The wooden bead is immersed in scarlet snake blood and then dried until no blood stains remain on the surface. "A red snake bodes well when it graces one's residence." It carries inherently an auspicious Qi with a glow that dissipates any chill and poison within its reach and blesses one with good luck.
Desc_30.cn: 取用赤蛇血，浸以木珠，蛇血渗入其中，晾干后表不见血色，而蕴之于内。“赤蛇嘉应，照曜于室内”，此珠带祥瑞之气，而能照耀四方，光所遍及之处，寒气毒力便被光驱散，人身自得福佑。

Desc_31.en: The pendant is made of a piece of incense wood immersed in souldew with a thin silk string strung through it. The crimson dew seeps out from the wood like blood when touched by Cryotoxin and then evaporates to cleanse the poison, filling the air with the soothing aroma of wood and crimson dew.
Desc_31.cn: 汲取木中汁血，尽染香木，穿以丝绦，可成坠饰。此坠但遇寒毒，木血便从香木中渗出，如同血露沾于其上，倏忽，血露蒸成雾散于空中，化毒于缥缈之间，此时但闻木香、血露香，香透心脾。

Desc_32.en: A bird with blue feathers, red wings, and a white beak heralds mysterious fires wherever it flies. The figurine is made in the shape of an Azure Egret and painted blue with red wings because the divine egret is said to foretell the arrival of fire. It appears as if enveloped in invisible flames, capable of repelling cold Yin energy, but be careful not to cause any unwanted disasters.
Desc_32.cn: “有鸟焉，赤文青质而白喙，见则其邑有讹火”，若见此鸟，大火不久至。于是塑神鸟形，漆之以青，点之以朱羽，化之以灵气，则形神似朱羽青鹭，周身似有无形之火，而寒阴莫能扰，只是需谨慎勿致无名火。

Desc_33.en: The Magenta Seal is filled with the energy of the magenta sun which symbolizes fire and extreme Yang. It suits people born in the Yin hours of the day as it counters the innate Yin energy, prevents Cryotoxin, and even deters Yin spirits with the extreme Yang air.
Desc_33.cn: 阳气鼎盛，方为紫阳。紫阳赤印通体赤红，蕴以紫阳之气，而藏紫阳正火，适于生辰阴时之人佩戴，可与先天阴气相化，使阴阳调和。因其阳气至盛，寒毒阴气见而退避，难有敢近之者，亦可用于驱阴鬼。

Desc_34.en: The Shatang tree leads one on a wondrous voyage across the oceans. The divine Shatang tree may evade and will water for its own gain, an ability possessed by the Shatang orb as well. It makes chilling water evaporate and prevents it from harming the body. One may even roam the ethereal realm of the heavens as the orb turns the chill into nourishment for the body and mind.
Desc_34.cn: “泛彼沧海，眇然遐游”，沙棠具避水使水之能，沙棠宝珠亦含此道，非驱而退之，乃化而用之。以此化游渺然之意境，而胜水寒阴敝，使之非但不可侵害人体，更或许可悠悠然化其为有用之物补益身心。

Desc_35.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas reads, "Xihe is the wife of Emperor Jun and the mother of the ten suns." Xihe is the goddess of the sun who gave birth to the ten suns that are the source of all Yang energy across heaven and earth. The Xihe Seal may also generate Yang energy from chaos and the darkest nights, cleansing anything Yin and ominous it encounters and filling its surroundings with a Yang air.
Desc_35.cn: 《山海经》：“羲和者，帝俊之妻，生十日”，羲和乃十日之母，化生天地间一切阳气之源。此羲和印亦可生阳气于混沌，产烈气于暗夜，寒阴晦气遇之则化，凡所过处，阳气渐起。

Desc_36.en: The dirt and filth blew away in the wind, spring and morning dew on bamboo. The snow-white Cleansing Orb may absorb filth and evil air and change color as it takes in more unclean energy. It may also be used to clean clothes.
Desc_36.cn: “风泉竹露净衣尘”，净衣珠洁白如雪，可吸纳污垢邪气，污浊越深，净衣珠也将随之变色。有人以此珠用作清洁衣物，十分便利。
Desc_36.ru: Грязь и нечистоты унесло ветром, весенняя и утренняя роса осела на бамбуке. Белоснежный очищающий шар может поглощать грязь и злой воздух и менять цвет по мере того, как он впитывает больше нечистой Энергии. Его также можно использовать для чистки одежды.

Desc_37.en: The 108 prayer beads are dyed with lotus leaves until they appear deep green. They emit a pure and pungent fragrance that detoxes and resists odor, and one may chant scriptures while wearing them to immerse the body in the scent so that their body may be preserved long after death.
Desc_37.cn: 取数珠一百零八颗，以荷叶染，待数珠皆呈浓绿色，乃为绿沉。此珠闻香清冽，有驱毒驱臭之用，常以此诵经数次，珠中香气可染全身，纵是身死也可较长时间身躯不腐。

Desc_38.en: A timely rain could save a thousand lives, and this Rain Twig is picked from a sprouting tree after such a rainstorm. Once nourished by rainwater, it now boasts the ability to breathe new life into what it touches. Those who carry the twig may have their festering wounds or injuries heal over time.
Desc_38.cn: 三尺甘霖，可救万民，甘霖枝取用旱后雨中所生枝条制成。枝曾得甘霖之养，润润青青，此枝拂处，亦有物感其气而生发，若身有腐败处，常携此枝可使患处血肉渐生。

Desc_39.en: The Collection of Key Passages from the Scripture reads, "The divine one who is born in the muddy filth sits upon the lotus pedestal." Guanyin sits on a thousand-petal lotus that keeps away the filth of the secular world and achieves tranquility. The wood pedestal is carved in the shape of the Guanyin lotus and may purify the faithful from the filth of their corporeal body.
Desc_39.cn: 《诸经要解》：“生于淤泥之浊，俱坐于莲台之上”，观音以千瓣莲为座，不染世之浊，而得一方净土地。木雕千瓣莲座，以其心诚，亦得以辟除肉身之芜秽，而得肉身之清净。

Desc_40.en: The box emanates a fragrance when opened, and those who smell it may hear heavenly and ethereal music as if in the presence of a Gandharva. If one is faithful enough, it shields their body from filth, poison, and any harm done by ghosts or deities, but if not, the music and fragrance will gradually fade.
Desc_40.cn: 此物开盒则有香气，嗅香则闻乐音，缥缈隐约似天乐，如见寻香神。寻香之际，若人心诚，则鬼神不能侵，浊气不能染，肉体凡胎得庇护，若心不诚，则乐音渐无，香气渐消，此宝当无用处。

Desc_41.en: Mortals that have completed all ten virtues and remained virtuous may be reborn in Sukhavati, the Land of Bliss. Following the Buddha's teachings, the box turns withered wood into earth and preserves rotting flesh. If those who practice with the box are eventually enlightened, their body may rejuvenate naturally and stop rotting as if reborn.
Desc_41.cn: 四道众生，若修十善业，饮八功德水，可于极乐净土中分别化生。此盒乃取佛意，用之枯木成土，敛之不腐之盒，怀之抱之，修之悟之，若能得其大道，肉身将有如化生重塑，而渐成不腐之身。

Desc_42.en: In the jug, spring thrives with flowing brooks and fresh water that breathes life into things. The Springbrook Jug seems to hold the liveliness of spring as the water within doesn't spoil despite the passage of time. It seeps into the wood jug and then the skin, with a miraculous effect of rejuvenation that turns rotten flesh and poisonous air into nourishment for the body until the skin glows again.
Desc_42.cn: 壶绘春涧图，壶盛春涧流，春涧水泉香，浊化万物生。春涧壶中似藏有春意，壶中水不因时转而腐坏，沁入壶木中，再化入肌肤，有腐物生春之奇效，将腐肉毒气化为蕴养新肌之底，而人肌肤含春，明艳可喜。

Desc_43.en: With his healing expertise, Wuxian serves as Emperor Yao's healer to heal the sick and prolong good fortune. Legend has it that Shaman Wuxian once healed ailments and blessed people with an orb. This orb seems to have similar abilities to cure illnesses and drive out poison, granting one with spiritual Qi, good health, and fortune.
Desc_43.cn: “巫咸，以鸿术为尧之医，能祝延人之福，愈人之病”，传说巫咸曾以宝珠愈病赐福。今所造宝珠似遗留上古时福佑之力，可退百病，除百毒，而人得宝珠灵气，生息渐长，身体康健，亦可得福避害，乃为灵物。

Desc_44.en: Nüwa created mankind by instilling divine power into clay dolls and granting them the ability to reproduce. The Nüwa Painting is a reimagination of the story, and it is blessed with part of the goddess's divine power that offers one the spiritual energy of life and facilitates rejuvenation if they suffer from rotten flesh.
Desc_44.cn: 娲皇抟土造人，以神力加于土偶，使之获生繁衍。娲皇图绘娲皇造人之景，得些许昔日附土为人之神力，乃能于天地间得“生”之气，而附于人上，若有肉腐坏不生，则以其力催生以灵，而世间难有腐可敌生者。

Desc_45.en: Made of bamboo strips twined together, the folding fan emanates the refreshing smell of bamboo and may circulate the surrounding air and facilitate the blood and Qi flows to drive out heat and umbritoxin.
Desc_45.cn: 青竹编制而成的扇，扁扁一片，扇得清风来，风伴竹清气。可流通周围空气，可促使经脉流转，排解燥热郁毒。
Desc_45.ru: Сделанный из переплетенных вместе бамбуковых полосок, складной вентилятор издает освежающий запах бамбука и может циркулировать в окружающем воздухе, способствуя циркуляции крови и Ци, выводя тепло и Умбротоксин.

Desc_46.en: The Musician Figurines are in ten forms, either holding a pipa, playing the guqin with head lowered, or playing drums... Each looks different with unique features. Those who see these figurines will be filled with joy and free from worry as if they could hear the pleasant music and see the warm smiles of the musicians.
Desc_46.cn: 彩戏乐俑有十种形象，或怀抱琵琶，或低头抚琴，或双手拨鼓……各个神态不一、陶然忘怀。观赏此佣亦会受其感染，似闻乐音，似见人笑，而心中喜悦，烦郁自去。

Desc_47.en: The Hundred Knots are made of soft and bendable twigs twined together in complex ways. They have an intricate structure and may be moved and pulled in all directions like a puzzle toy. Those who try to untie them will be engrossed in solving the puzzle and forget about their trouble.
Desc_47.cn: 取软木枝条，柔韧可弯，缠扭百道，错相结节，便是百缠错结扣。此物构造精妙，左拆右拉皆有可玩之处，戏者沉浸其中，忘却身边杂事，待回过神来，已胸怀大畅。

Desc_48.en: This bizarre vase resembles a ghost with carved hands, feet, a tiny head, and a drum-like belly. It lets out a thunderous noise when feeding on Umbritoxin during sunrise or sunset, and when the noise stops, it will have devoured all the poison.
Desc_48.cn: 此壶甚怪，雕有手脚并小头，肚大如鼓，似鬼形象。此壶喜食郁毒之气，旦夕逢之，便闻听壶腹中雷鸣鼓转，待声响停歇，郁气已不知何时被壶吞入。
Desc_48.ru: Эта причудливая ваза напоминает привидение с вырезанными руками, ногами, крошечной головой и брюшком, похожим на барабан. Он издает оглушительный шум, когда питается Умбротоксином во время восхода или заката солнца, а когда шум прекратится, он поглотит весь Яд.

Desc_49.en: The seven orifices on one's head allow one to see, listen, eat, and breathe. The basket is made of softwood strips braided together with seven openings that correspond to the seven vital orifices of human beings. It absorbs and cleanses Qi through the seven openings, so those who carry it will take in only clean energy and dispel poison.
Desc_49.cn: “人有七窍以视听食息”，以软木编篮，于枢要处记得凿取七个窍孔，以类人之七窍。此篮有吸气化气之异能，气自此七窍入，毒自此七窍出，则因此人之吸入俱为清气，人之呼出亦被此篮化毒。

Desc_50.en: The Wind-Proof Orb may not only resist the physical wind but also prevent things from troubling the mind. Those who carry it will be free from worldly worries and depressing thoughts, as the mind achieves peace and serenity.
Desc_50.cn: 定风珠具有定风止风之能，非止凡尘风，亦是心中风。于人之烦忧时，得风之止息，便可不受世事所扰，心中自宁，郁气自化。
Desc_50.ru: Ветрозащитный шар может не только противостоять физическому ветру, но и препятствовать тому, чтобы что-то беспокоило разум. Те, кто носит его, будут свободны от мирских забот и угнетающих мыслей, поскольку ум достигает покоя и безмятежности.

Desc_51.en: The Peach Bloom Fan is carved from wood growing in a blessed cave and painted with peach blossoms. Often held by young ladies, the fan emits a refreshing floral fragrance that drives out depressant poisons from the body and surrounds one in a natural aroma.
Desc_51.cn: 扇绘桃花，扇骨以龙穴之木雕成，是为龙骨桃花扇。多以女子持得，相映方美，此扇挥之则有清淡桃花香气，香入肺腑，化郁解毒于胸腔，又透魂入骨，用之者周身、内里常带香气。

Desc_52.en: From the balance of Yin and Yang comes all life. People shun Yin and seek Yang, which eventually converges in a harmonious balance. The Three Primes and one Qi originate from all beings and achieve balance since Qi is a mixture of Yin and Yang. The orb adjusts the balance of Yin and Yang and maintains the harmony of Qi to repel depressant auras, as it supplements Yang or Yin energy based on the surrounding atmosphere until it achieves a perfect balance.
Desc_52.cn: “三生万物，负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和”，三元一气，本自万物，因气含阴阳而自和。此珠功可调阴阳、冲而和，但逢周边万物生息，若阳衰则补阳，阴衰则补阴，终使得生息调和，无处致郁。

Desc_53.en: Made of Purpletwist Bamboo, this rare purplish black incense burner emits a spiritual fragrance when incense is burned, appeasing all the sorrow, guilt, and depression in one's mind and releasing the feelings into the air to shield one from agony and pain.
Desc_53.cn: 只有以九曲紫竹为引，方能成此罕有香炉。此炉通身紫黑，质地沉着，焚香其中，香气如有精魂，钻入人心，抚慰心中一切痛楚、哀怜、郁苦，更化入空中，时时护佑人不受郁苦侵袭。

Desc_54.en: The emerald bracelet is made of honed bamboo strips twined together. It is not merely a fine accessory, but also capable of reducing inflammation and pain due to its cold nature.
Desc_54.cn: 取细竹打磨后圈结成环，得一只碧玉般竹环。佩于手腕处，不仅色质兼美，且以其清凉性，有些许消炎止痛之功效。
Desc_54.ru: Изумрудный браслет сделан из отточенных бамбуковых полосок, переплетенных вместе. Это не просто прекрасный аксессуар, но и способный уменьшить воспаление и боль благодаря своей холодной природе.

Desc_55.en: The root of a tree shaped like a Buddhist monk, now worshipped by those who seek blessings. The wood figurine is believed to have the Buddha's abilities to bless one with good fortune for it is carved in the shape of a Buddhist. It must be kept by a faithful believer and may not be exposed to the sun for long or placed close to fire."By chance, I assumed the title of The Wooden Kulapati, attracting countless seekers of blessings." The Wooden Kulapati is a wooden carved deity, humorously referred to as "Kulapati."
Desc_55.cn: “偶然题作木居士，便有无穷求福人”，木居士乃木雕神像，世人以“居士”谑称，因其形象世人以为有福佑之能。此木雕不可长期曝晒、不可近火，需虔心保管。

Desc_56.en: The flower basket is made of soft twigs braided together and adorned with a couple of dewy and fragrant flowers, which seem to be growing naturally from the ground. It is cold to the touch, and when placed in heat, the dew will evaporate to resist it. It loses this effect all the dew evaporates.
Desc_56.cn: 以柔韧枝条编制成花篮，取数朵带露鲜花缀于其间，成物鲜艳美丽，芳香飘送。其上花、露、枝条似本就生于一处，触之清冷，若遇炽热、烈气，露便化而相抗，待花篮温同俗物，便已是竭尽全力。

Desc_57.en: The goblet is carved from a thick vine naturally shaped like a Loong due to its inherent Loong aura. If muddy water is placed in it, the dirt will be drawn by the wood and settle at the bottom, miraculously leaving only clean water that tastes sweet and is cold.
Desc_57.cn: 以粗壮藤木雕成木杯，随势而作，而杯自如龙形，乃因木带龙气。若以此杯盛浊水，静待片刻，则浊受木引，渐为沉淀，而水质清冽可透底，饮之亦觉凉爽甘甜，实乃古藤杯之奇。

Desc_58.en: No graceful dancer in red sleeves to entertain me through the night, only the jade bamboo wife to bring me cold and calm. The jade bamboo wife is made of vines and bamboo strips woven together. It is a cylinder with holes that allow a greater flow of air to bring relief in the summer heat when held or placed against the body.
Desc_58.cn: “我无红袖堪娱夜，正要青奴一味凉”，碧血青奴乃是藤枝与竹篾编制而成的取凉用具，其质中空，周编网眼可穿风，可拥可跷，皆能为人带来清凉之感、清凉之风。

Desc_59.en: As cold as frost, the Frosthaze Orb does not thaw in the heat, break upon impact, or change its shape. In hot air or extreme heat, one may hold this orb so that its coldness may seep into one's body and mind until the uncomfortable heat dissipates.
Desc_59.cn: 凝结不动为凝绝，凝绝珠清冷似凝冰，但不因热而化，不因撞而毁，不随物而易。人遇热气热力，可握此珠，则凉意自珠中渗入人身、人心，热气退去，冰冰凉凉，好不适意。
Desc_59.ru: Холодный, как иней, шар Frosthaze не оттаивает на жаре, не разбивается при ударе и не меняет своей формы. В жарком воздухе или при сильной жаре человек может держать этот шар так, чтобы его холод проникал в его тело и разум до тех пор, пока неприятное тепло не рассеется.

Desc_60.en: Spirit Wood is born from the purified essence of spiritual Qi from the earth. It changes form in different locations and contains the natural Yin power of the earth that dissolves any Acritoxin it encounters.
Desc_60.cn: 灵木化地之精气而成型，乃是地宝，取其灵气核枢处，去污除杂，便得此物。此宝常因地气而换形，形态不一，其中自然纳有地阴蕴养之力，若遇炽烈毒气，力便与之所化，使毒气不生。
Desc_60.ru: Дерево Духа рождается из очищенной эссенции духовной Ци земли. Он меняет форму в разных местах и содержит природную силу Инь земли, которая растворяет любой Акритоксин, с которым сталкивается.

Desc_61.en: Cut from a tree that naturally grows near a Fengshui Loong Lair, the Blessed Heritage is a rare part that is connected to a ley line, nourished by spiritual Qi, and may not be planted or grown by mortal beings. It concentrates the blessed Qi from the ley line and fears no flame or Yang poison as it dispels them at will.
Desc_61.cn: 风水龙穴处所生树木，得灵气蕴养而成，截其与地脉相连处便为先天龙脉。此物只因天时地利而成，人不可养育，集龙脉之龙气，灵似活物，不惧炎炽、不惧阳毒，皆随意化之而去。

Desc_62.en: To liberate from the causes and effects in the cycle of life and death is the state of nirvana. The Great Nirvana Orb is a relic that has been liberated from the causes and effects and transcended life and death beyond the eighteen dhatus. Those who carry it may attain enlightenment and achieve a calm and worry-free state of mind where there is no suffering or desire and enter the "Ultimate Equanimity."
Desc_62.cn: “轮转生死中，不受诸因缘，是名为涅槃”，涅槃珠本已灭尽因缘，超脱生死，乃是十八界之外宝物。人携之可助于证道，若得入涅槃之境，自此便不必再受风吹雨打、严寒日晒，能够得知清凉寂静，烦恼不现，谓之为“无上清凉”。

Desc_63.en: The seal is made of bamboo plates hanging on a pole that clatter when walking. The noise it makes may help one stay alert and warn them against potential danger in special circumstances.
Desc_63.cn: 青竹所制信符，以竹片悬于竿上，行路便闻竹片相击嗒嗒作响，乃为凭信之证。其声响常可醒人神，其高举之意亦可于万一时警人魂。
Desc_63.ru: Печать сделана из бамбуковых пластин, подвешенных на шесте, которые позвякивают при ходьбе. Издаваемый им шум может помочь человеку оставаться начеку и предупредить его о Потенциале опасности в особых обстоятельствах.

Desc_64.en: The box contains magnolia petals that emanate a faint but lasting fragrance, which cleanses the mind and body of those who smell it as if awakened by silver moonlight.
Desc_64.cn: 山中香兰玉色新，藏之于盒，清雅幽香韵味长。此盒时时散发芳香，时时洗涤心肺，闻者如见明月光，自清自醒。
Desc_64.ru: Коробка содержит лепестки магнолии, которые источают слабый, но стойкий аромат, который очищает разум и тело тех, кто вдыхает его, словно пробужденный серебряным лунным светом.

Desc_65.en: Men do not know the trouble of ghosts; like men do not know the Wisdom King who guards the world. The Ghost Purger is a brown bead that has dark stripes within and is said to be capable of purging evil ghosts and protecting all minds from trouble and worry.
Desc_65.cn: “鬼愁不愁，人亦不知，如彼明王，守在四夷”，鬼见愁乃茶褐色圆珠，中有深黑色纹理。传言此物可却厌邪鬼，又如明玉守护四方，守人神识，灭人烦恼。

Desc_66.en: It is a string of incredibly tough bodhi beads that become shinier as one uses them to pray, capable of repelling evil and preventing disasters. Those who chant scriptures while holding the beads will instill divine power into them, which helps one focus the mind and ignore all distractions.
Desc_66.cn: 菩提所结子串成念珠串，坚硬无比，愈磨愈亮，可驱邪避祸。“凡持诵时，真言印契，收摄其心”，常常持诵，真言化入菩提子，功可收摄人心，心神便不易为外物扰动。

Desc_67.en: The touch of vines awakens me; to the rustle of pine leaves I listen with thee. The intricate cage is made of soft vines and grasses woven together in which incense is burned, enveloping one in a haze as if in a dream. Within the mist is a natural woody fragrance that clears and calms the mind and body when one breathes it in.
Desc_67.cn: “醉向丝萝惊自醒，与君清耳听松湍”，用软藤草丝编成精巧笼状，可焚香其中，烟雾缥缈笼罩身边，人似入华胥之梦，雾中又有丝萝之天然清气，待闻其清，惊而自醒，不多时便耳目清静，心中安宁。

Desc_68.en: The Rekindle Lamp shines blue with scattering ash like fireflies when burning fresh twigs. Spirits of the dead would approach the blue light, and if one lingers, they may slowly regain consciousness and return to their physical form.
Desc_68.cn: 返魂灯乃一盏青灯，燃青枝则光青荧，偶有散屑如萤火纷飞。以其青冥幽远，而魂魄亲之，若有时三魂惊去，却因不舍此灯而流连，待神魂知觉，又可渐返回得人身。
Desc_68.ru: Лампа Rekindle светится голубым светом, рассеивая пепел, похожий на светлячков при сжигании свежих веток. Духи умерших приближаются к синему свету, и если кто-то задержится, они могут медленно прийти в сознание и вернуться к своей физической форме.

Desc_69.en: The face like the mid-autumn full moon; eyes like a pure lotus bloom. The statue is carved in the shape of Ananda to assist one in learning and understanding the Buddha's teachings. Meaning untarnished, Ananda is one of the Buddha's ten principal disciples with a firm will and clear mind that upholds justice and never succumbs to temptation.
Desc_69.cn: “相如秋满月，眼似净莲华”，以此清净形象雕阿难陀宝像，便如时时得阿难陀开示。阿难陀意为无染，其志操坚固、心如明镜，受阿难陀训诫，心中存有正理，不受诸般诱惑，意志如泰山般不易转移。

Desc_70.en: As written in the Heart Sutra, the Tathata is "a natural absence of all things, neither living nor dying, neither filthy nor clean, neither growing nor dwindling." The Mirror of Truth reflects one's true self and leaves no shadows in their mind. One will realize there is no self, no truth, nor illusion, and eventually break free from the hallucinations.
Desc_70.cn: 据《般若心经》所述真如之意：“是诸法空相，不生不灭，不垢不净，不增不减”，真如镜可照见人心中影，于是方知世上无我，无实虚、真妄，既解破其理，又何来被虚妄所困之时？

Desc_71.en: Tumi, or roseleaf raspberry, once only grew in the heavens. All evil in one's mind will be purged at the sight of this white and delicate flower, as the Buddha believed it to be auspicious. The spirit of the purple bamboo transformed into the flower to seek a clear mind in the world of mortals. "To know the truth of all beings, to dispel evil, to follow nature, and to break free from desire." It frees the mind from the troubles of dreams and illusions.
Desc_71.cn: 荼糜本乃天上花，色白质软，但见此花，恶自除去，佛视之以为吉。紫竹以精魂幻化成此花，于人世间但求一心了然，观花便可“了万法，恶尽除，应物而无情”，于万物看清，不受一切梦幻所扰。

Desc_72.en: Embroidered with plants and animals, the tigerskin pouch may be used to keep one alert or awake Thanks to the aroma of the shag tobacco that is held within. Since it is often placed next to the skin, the pouch used to be exchanged as a token of love.
Desc_72.cn: 虎衣缝制的巴掌大小荷包，上绣花鸟兽鱼，可盛烟丝于其中。布料之野气受烟丝之熏陶，有警敏之效。因其贴身常用，旧时亦用于传情。
Desc_72.ru: Кисет из тигровой кожи, расшитый растениями и животными, можно использовать для поддержания бодрости или бодрствования благодаря аромату махорки, который содержится внутри. Поскольку его часто кладут рядом с кожей, мешочком раньше обменивались в знак любви.

Desc_73.en: Legend has it that the Sinner's Drum's skin was once made of evildoers' faces, but now it is simply made of a beast hide embroidered with a human mouth and noise. It hums in the wind, the sound of which awakes the mind and reminds one to reflect on themselves.
Desc_73.cn: 传说最初人面鼓乃是用恶人之面制成双鼓面而成。今以兽皮为鼓面，上绣人之口鼻，遇风则嗡嗡自鸣，闻此声者不由得自醒自清，心中常常警醒。

Desc_74.en: The evils fall, upon the stars' call. The tough and durable leather scabbard is made for swords that slay evil and intimidate anyone greedy and cruel. Once out of the scabbard, a sword would strike any evildoers as if blessed by the constellations in the sky. Therefore, the scabbard is often used to encourage retrospection and integrity.
Desc_74.cn: “景星在天，青狼自落”，此方鞘由皮革制成，坚韧耐用，专存斩奸邪之刀剑，贪狠之人见之则惧，刃出而凶残自落，似有星宿保佑。因此此鞘常使人自省自悟，催人奋进。

Desc_75.en: The Pixiu is a mythical beast with the power of thousands of troops that feeds on evil spirits. The Pixiu Pouch is embroidered with the fearsome Pixiu which has the head and tail of a Loong and body of a tiger. Those who carry the pouch will be blessed with courage and good luck.
Desc_75.cn: 貔貅又名辟邪，专食猛兽邪灵，凶猛勇武可比百万之师。貔貅包绣以龙首尾、虎豹形之貔貅，威风凛凛，人见之则胆气自生。常携此物，亦可避祸趋吉。

Desc_76.en: Hebo drives away Loongs with the beating of Hebo Drum. Hebo is the god of the Yellow River who beats their drums to deliver messages from the heavens, thus returning deities and Loongs to their original states within the order. Made from spiritual objects, it encourages those who hear it to move quickly in tandem with the drum.
Desc_76.cn: “冯夷击鼓群龙趋”，冯夷鼓乃神界讯息，闻听此声，则神归元位，群龙趋走，井然有序。取通灵之物制成冯夷鼓，鼓响则人奋，身手随鼓行，轻捷有序。

Desc_77.en: Loongs and snakes slither as speedily as lightning bolts. Adorned with hundreds of gems, the snakeskin pouch is embroidered with a Loong and only used as inspiration, for those who carry it will learn the swift movements of the Loong and snake and become as fast and agile as these beasts.
Desc_77.cn: “时时只见龙蛇走，左盘右蹙如惊电”，用蛇皮为袋，上缀百种珍宝，绣有龙形。此袋不用来藏物，只以其形气激人，携此袋者从中可悟龙蛇之行，行步出招亦迅如龙蛇。

Desc_78.en: The brilliant golden scabbard feels burning to the touch as if flames were concealed within. As it combines metal and fire, it may miraculously counter and melt metal with the formless fire, and those who comprehend the way of the amorphous fire and metal could turn problems into opportunities.
Desc_78.cn: 此鞘金光溢目，乃用金色筋布制成，鞘中如藏火，触之则似受火烧。因其融会金火，以火之无形，克金之有形，又化金于无形，神妙莫测，得道者可象金火之变换，化己之形势。

Desc_79.en: Hou Yi once shot down the nine suns and saved everyone. The casket conceals Hou Yi's arrows with the energy of his speed, which courses through one's body and makes one as swift as flying arrows, so swift that no one can track their movements.
Desc_79.cn: 大羿曾射九日，箭无虚发，势可破空，而救万民。后以匣藏箭，则匣亦含灵武之气，此气穿梭人身，冥冥中带动身心，功如灵变，迅如箭势，他人难辨其行动。
Desc_79.ru: Хоу И однажды сбил "девять солнц" и спас всех. Шкатулка скрывает стрелы Хоу И с Энергией его скорости, которая проходит сквозь тело человека и делает его таким же быстрым, как летящие стрелы, настолько быстрым, что никто не может уследить за их движениями.

Desc_80.en: To the flow of the banner sound the thunderous beats of the drum. The spiritual banner waves in the wind and with it comes an overwhelming roar of thunder, which motivates those who hear it and grants them indomitable might and the ability to change everything around them in an instant.
Desc_80.cn: “灵旗百万驱雷鼓”，灵物制灵旗，威风凛凛，风翩翩则灵旗动，灵旗动则雷鼓鸣，惊天骇地，势无可挡。人受雷鸣声驱使，藏风云变换之能力，瞬息万变其架势，亦势无可挡。

Desc_81.en: Woven from jute fibers, the sachet contains herbal ingredients that emit a pungent but refreshing aroma. Young ladies would also wear this sachet as perfume.
Desc_81.cn: 以黄麻丝线缠成，中藏药草香料，气味浓烈，可通气提神。女子亦会用此物来熏得体香。
Desc_81.ru: Саше, сотканное из джутовых волокон, содержит растительные ингредиенты, которые издают острый, но освежающий аромат. Юные леди также использовали бы это саше в качестве духов.

Desc_82.en: Warm airs give rise to the zephyr, a breeze of refreshment. The Zephyr Clout is a fragrant handkerchief that smells pleasant and heartwarming as though the gentle spring breeze blows, making one content and clear-minded.
Desc_82.cn: “熏风，巽气所生，一曰清明风”，熏风帕乃是一方香帕，其香暖而馨，闻如春风拂面，可使人心中满足、气清神明。
Desc_82.ru: Теплый воздух порождает зефир, освежающий бриз. Zephyr Clout - это ароматный носовой платок, который приятно и согревающе пахнет, как будто дует нежный весенний ветерок, делая человека довольным и с ясным умом.

Desc_83.en: The golden osmanthus flowers bloom in small clusters, like rice grains in autumn. The pouch contains sweet-scented osmanthus flowers and emanates an aroma that reaches far and wide. Those who smell it would feel refreshed and nourished as if basking in the silver moonlight on Mid-Autumn Day.
Desc_83.cn: 桂花金黄，细小却繁，正如金粟。金粟袋以袋盛桂花，其香气清甜绝尘，远溢四方，人闻之如中秋时见夜深月圆，更露重重，不由得神清气爽，此物亦有蕴养肺腑之效。

Desc_84.en: As pure as the snow shroud; as bright as the moon in the clouds. The embroidery painting is woven from a variety of silk into a silver, bright moon between the clouds, which shines over the world and illuminates one's mind. It is highly praised for the intricate and ingenious weaves.
Desc_84.cn: “皑如山上雪，皎若云间月”，此物乃一件绣品，以百丝百锦绘云间之月，其月也皎皎，不亚天上婵娟，照人心中如白雪洁净。因其巧夺天工，见之者莫不称奇。

Desc_85.en: The Amitayurdhyana Sutra reads, "Beneath this ground of lapis lazuli there will be seen a Trove Pagoda with the seven jewels, diamonds, and the rest, supporting the ground." The seven jewels of gold, silver, glaze, amber, tridacna, and agate are embroidered on the gold banner that ring in the wind. Those who hold it may find clarity in their mind as they adjust their breathing to the wind.
Desc_85.cn: 《观无量寿佛经》：“有金刚七宝金幢，擎瑠璃地”。以金、银、琉璃、珊瑚、琥珀、砗磲、玛瑙此七宝缀金线所织金幢之上，随风则叮当作响，擎者观照，心有妙想，通透似琉璃，感风之息，气随风变。

Desc_86.en: The pouch collects chaotic energy between heaven and earth and returns it to Primordial Qi. Hence. It holds Qi that is neither clear nor dirty, neither Yin nor Yang. It may keep supplementing one with an endless supply of Qi, as the energy inside the pouch is neutral and impervious in nature, and it gathers from a limitless natural source.
Desc_86.cn: 将天地之气收归于袋，混沌为一，化为元气之始。因此袋中藏无清无浊、无阴无阳之气，当气从袋出，可补人行动时气之不足，又因天地之气无穷，袋中气亦无穷。

Desc_87.en: The Sky-Mirroring Pouch is woven from spiritual silk and as bright and clean as a mirror reflecting the sky, so the void energy of the heavens is contained within. Qi inside the pouch is clear and nourishing, capable of cleansing one's body and Qi flow.
Desc_87.cn: 涵虚袋用灵丝织成，因丝光亮洁净，织袋便如明镜映天，天之气因此纳于袋中，地实天虚，故名“涵虚”。袋中气俱清，若入人肺腑，不止可补气，亦可清气，使身心洁净，而事半功倍。

Desc_88.en: Fragrant silk clothing as light as snowflakes that flows without the wind, the garment was left behind by a celestial maiden after ascension. Those who wear the ethereal garment may feel as light as a feather and dance elegantly with the wind like an Immortal.
Desc_88.cn: 仙子羽化而落下香罗轻衣于人间，轻软如薄雪，无风亦飘飞。着此香罗衣，身心轻似羽，含气化气，登风起舞，灵动之处亦如仙子飘飘然。

Desc_89.en: The piece of Cloudlight Clout encompasses all rare and natural phenomena, and once unfolded, it will be enveloped in a rosy, dazzling, and flowing light. Those who carry it will feel unencumbered while moving, as if riding on clouds and could reach any corner of the world.
Desc_89.cn: 万象云光帕包罗万象之珍，本乃仙家法宝，展帕便见云光岚彩，流于周身，光华非凡。行动时只见云光摇晃，身随心动，呼吸云气，自在自行，如同腾云驾雾，只觉天地之大莫有不能至者。

Desc_90.en: Simply woven from rags, the Cloth Pouch is durable and convenient with enough space to hold belongings.
Desc_90.cn: 碎布缀成的布口袋，简单而耐磨，便于携带使用，可以容纳些许物品。
Desc_90.ru: Тканевый мешочек, просто сплетенный из тряпок, прочен и удобен, в нем достаточно места для хранения вещей.

Desc_91.en: The square sachet is cut from a complete beast hide and embroidered with a wild animal. It is intact and durable with fine fleece to resist the cold.
Desc_91.cn: 一整块兽皮制成的方囊，还绣有野兽形象，上有细绒且光泽，其完整而不易破损，有些微保暖之效。
Desc_91.ru: Квадратное саше вырезано из цельной звериной шкуры и расшито изображением дикого животного. Она цела и прочна благодаря тонкому флису, который защищает от холода.

Desc_92.en: With embroidered fire, Loong, axe, and bow patterns, Scholar Sack symbolizes one's literary competence. The sack was once used by students on their journey to the imperial exams. It is often embroidered with various patterns to not only symbolize one's integrity but also their literary talent.
Desc_92.cn: “火、龙、黼、黻、昭其文也”，昭文袋乃旧时学子进京赶考常用的大袋，可盛装较多行李。其上常绣有各式花纹，以示君子之证，更可显扬其人有文采、俱德行。

Desc_93.en: The Goldfish Pouch was once only granted to high-ranking imperial officials and used to contain a gold token of a fancy carp. Now embroidered with fish in gold and silver threads, it is used to preserve a myriad of small items and seen as a symbol of fortune.
Desc_93.cn: 旧时官制，三品以上方可用金鱼袋，最初用于盛鲤鱼状金符，后改其制，只在袋上用金银饰为鱼型。此袋不仅可盛物防坏，可容各类零碎小物，并有富贵之义。

Desc_94.en: The Book of Han reads, "The grand chancellor in the Qin Dynasty was bestowed with a gold seal and purple ribbons." Purple ribbons were once only worn by the most superior imperial officials to symbolize Propitious Qi and their high status. Embroidered with crape myrtles, the Purple Ribbon Sachet is shiny and smooth to the touch—indeed a precious item with both practicality and aesthetic value.
Desc_94.cn: 《汉书》：“相国、丞相，皆秦官，金印紫绶”，古时只有极高位官员可用此紫绶，乃取紫气东来之意，华贵非常。紫绶方囊色紫黑，绣有紫薇花，质地细腻有光泽，实用且美观，他人见此皆以为贵。

Desc_95.en: The sachet woven from gold and silver threads often contains flower petals and spices to either be carried for their fragrance or hanged in a room to repel insects. It may not wear out even after years as it is made from gold and silver silk.
Desc_95.cn: 以金银丝线装饰织造而成的花囊，内中常存花瓣香料，佩于身边可使肌体含香，亦可挂于帐中驱虫生香，极为风雅。因由金银丝制成，柔韧非常，用之数年也不见丝毫磨损。
Desc_95.ru: Саше, сплетенное из золотых и серебряных нитей, часто содержит лепестки цветов и специи, которые можно носить с собой для придания им аромата или повесить в комнате для отпугивания насекомых. Оно может не изнашиваться даже по прошествии многих лет, так как изготовлено из золотого и серебряного шелка.

Desc_96.en: At night, there is a huge pouch that inhales twice before breathing out a strong gust of wind... It is the source of wind, commanding it wind and the weather. Fengbo, the Taoist deity of the wind, created the pouch by capturing the source of wind, so that he may take it in or let it out at his pleasure. Shaped like a small swallow, it has enough space to contain all the energy in the world and can be used to carry belongings without tiring the carrier.
Desc_96.cn: “夜半见一物大如囊，吸气二口喷出，狂风骤发……能掌八风消息，通五运之气候”，风伯擒风母为袋，可收风、致风，形如飞燕，虽小但能容天地之气，堪称神通，携带常物亦不在话下，亦不使人觉负累。

Desc_97.en: The Prismatic Sachet is woven from the glowing silk of seven colors that twinkles like the stars above the heavens. It is always surrounded by a misty wind, and those that match the sachet in mind and spirit may become as agile as if soaring above the sky.
Desc_97.cn: 彩缕仙囊以彩色丝线制成，色有七彩，各自流光，若群星闪烁，华美非凡间物。此囊边上，常绕雾飘风，若与用者心神相同，更可抛掷灵活如翔于空中。

Desc_98.en: Sumeru in a tiny seed; the whole universe in a linen pouch. The Universe Pouch may seem like an ordinary linen pouch with horns, but it in fact contains the ultimate way of creation. It shrinks to the size of a seed when not in use, and expands to hold all things inside without changing its shape. It is even said to be large enough to encompass the universe but mortals cannot unleash its true power.
Desc_98.cn: 芥子纳须弥，叉袋藏乾坤。乾坤叉袋其貌不扬，形如麻袋，上有叉角，却蕴天地间元生万物之理，不用时袋可缩如芥子大小，若盛物便可自然放开，百物容于其间，袋却不显其大。更闻听其可藏纳天地，只是人不能尽其用。

Desc_99.en: The shiny black Blackstone Ring is worn on the thumb to avoid abrasion. Once a protective accessory equipped by nomads for shooting arrows, it is now seen as a symbol of bravery and strength.
Desc_99.cn: 黑石扳指漆黑发亮，戴于拇指上可避免磨伤，旧时外族常于拉弓搭箭时佩戴此物，本是一件防护饰品，后渐渐变为勇猛之象征。
Desc_99.ru: Блестящее черное кольцо с черным камнем надевается на большой палец, чтобы избежать истирания. Когда-то это был защитный аксессуар кочевников для стрельбы из лука, теперь он рассматривается как символ храбрости и Силы.

Desc_100.en: Since the Han dynasty, strong warriors have put these tough jadestone bracelets around their forearms not only as bracers for brawls and fights, but also to boost their courage. Curvier ladies also wear these armlets for beauty and style.
Desc_100.cn: “环臂谓之钏”，臂钏自汉朝出现，后有力士将此玉石钏束于臂腕间，因其坚硬，于搏击时可作护臂之用，力士因之也更加勇武敢斗。亦有丰腴女子佩戴臂钏，美观而有丰韵。
Desc_100.ru: Со времен династии Хань сильные воины надевали эти прочные браслеты из жадеита на предплечья не только как наручи для драк, но и для придания им храбрости. Дамы с пышными формами также носят эти нарукавники для красоты и стиля.

Desc_101.en: An unbreakable stone stele with the might of a tiger that dispels evil and cures all illnesses. The Tai Stele, hewn with inscriptions, is from a stone on Mt. Tai. People often place it in distinct spots to ensure safety, as they believe with the power of Mt. Tai, the stele could suppress sinister energy. Those who carry it may borrow its miraculous power to subdue demons and prevent disasters.
Desc_101.cn: “师猛虎，石敢当，所不侵，龙未央”，石敢当乃是取泰山石刻字而成的石碑，世人以为其可借用泰山之力镇压不祥之气，常置于冲处或凶位，以保一方平安。若携带此物，或可借用其镇百鬼、压灾殃的奇力。

Desc_102.en: Legend has it that a sacred turtle supports the heavens and the three celestial mountains - Penglai, Fanghu, and Yingzhou - on its back, with its four feet each on one pole of the earth, capable of carrying anything in the world. The Jewel Turtle is crafted with firm eyes and adorned with a cornucopia of gems and stones. Many decorate their house with it as a symbol of blessing.
Desc_102.cn: 鳌足立四极、顶天立地，背驼蓬莱、方丈、瀛洲三仙山，堪载天地间一切重物。多宝鳌采用多种玉石装饰而成，塑成龟鳖形，鳌目威严，似含神力，世人常造此物用以镇宅，亦常祈福于此。

Desc_103.en: Si, a blue rhinoceros, is a mystical beast as ferocious as a tiger and is capable of killing a man. "Si resembles a blue bison with a horn that weighs 500 kilograms." The Tricolor Rhinoceros is glazed in three colors and made in the shape of a vivid blue rhinoceros, with muscles as hard as steel, angry eyes, and powerful hoofs. It looks vaguely translucent and symbolizes ultimate might and bravery.
Desc_103.cn: 青犀，又称兕，“兕如野牛而青，一角，重千斤”，其凶猛如虎，力可杀人。三彩青犀用三种釉色妆胎，所成青犀栩栩如生，筋挛仿佛硬如钢，怒目奋蹄，微透光泽，刚猛雄壮之意气感人夺目。

Desc_104.en: The Extensive Records of the Taiping Era reads, "The Dharmapala glares and thus slays all evil." The Dharmapala Statue is of a Dharmapala, the protector of Dharma, holding their Vajra and glaring at evil demons before them, and those in its presence feel both fear and a sense of security. The intimidating statue of the Dharmapala seems to have a divine power that eliminates all evil, which in turn inspires courageous fighters.
Desc_104.cn: 《太平广记》：“金刚怒目，所以降伏四魔”，怒目金刚像手擎法宝，双目圆睁突出，怒目而视，世人见之虽畏惧，但又知此像实是以怒目之状斩妖除魔，于是更觉安心。此等凶猛可惧之形象，似有神力可除尽天下邪魔，猛士见之反受其感染。

Desc_105.en: Erlang is the descendant of Cancong, the deity of silk moths, and born with a vertical third eye on his forehead. Erlang's third eye sees the truth and commands life and death with the power to move mountains and expose evil. Carved from a sacred stone, the eye may not be as powerful as the deity's real eye, but it also grants a divine power to break rocks and drive away evil.
Desc_105.cn: “二郎为蚕丛之后，故额上有一纵目”，纵目乃天所开，此眼所见之处，掌生杀之力，可开山劈石，邪祟无处遁形。此二郎眼用神石雕成，虽不比二郎真眼，但亦能赐人些许神力，断石劈虎所向披靡，而邪祟畏之。

Desc_106.en: Created by the Yellow Emperor, Ruyi was once a weapon used to fight Chi You and demons. Carved with a coiling azure Loong and tamed white tiger that symbolize divinity and energy, this Loong Tiger Ruyi enhances one's spiritual power and grants the courage to annihilate devils as it is imbued with the power of a divine stone.
Desc_106.cn: 如意乃是黄帝所制，曾为战蚩尤之兵器，可辟众魔。龙虎宝如意则刻有青龙蜿蜒、白虎驯服之形象，以喻神、气二道，因此此宝可通人之神气，而将神石之力灌于其中，使人增长除妖辟邪之勇。

Desc_107.en: The Book of Sui reads, "At the beginning of the world, Pangu parted chaos into the heavens and earth, raising mountains and deepening oceans." The Dawning Orb is made of a divine stone from the dawn of time that is told to have taken in the ultimate power of the ancient emperor, Pangu, which would be activated when polished. It is constantly releasing the overwhelming might and granting those who carry it the strength to defend against an entire army.
Desc_107.cn: 据《隋书》所载：“混沌之初，盘古开天辟地，峻岳夷海”，开天珠乃是取天地之初孕育出的神石制成，传说神石中吸收昔日盘古皇之无上大力，琢磨成珠可激发其中神力。此珠无时不刻不散发其威猛神力，携此物者受宝珠之力影响，有万夫莫开之奇劲。

Desc_108.en: The Agate Bracelet is a polished agate stone with complex patterning that appears like the brain of a horse. It is nourishing and chilly with effects to prevent ailments such as heat stroke.
Desc_108.cn: 玛瑙镯是用一整块玛瑙石打磨加工而成，其质文理交错，有如马脑。此镯清凉通透，石中玉髓养人，可防中暑等杂病。
Desc_108.ru: Браслет из агата - это полированный агатовый камень со сложным рисунком, который напоминает мозг лошади. Это питательное и прохладное блюдо помогает предотвратить такие заболевания, как тепловой удар.

Desc_109.en: Survival Locks are lock-shaped jewels made of metal or gems, among which jade locks are the most precious. Children often wear the Survival Locks to retain the energy of life and avoid disasters until they come of age, as people believe these locks could "keep away evil ghosts and ailments" so that children may not die at a young age.
Desc_109.cn: 长命锁呈锁状，乃是金石所造饰物，其中以玉石锁最为珍贵。其寓意锁住寿元，祛灾去邪，多为小儿佩戴，可“避鬼及兵，令人不病瘟”，从而防止夭折，成年时才可取下。

Desc_110.en: The Surangama Sutra reads, "The Earthwalker has sought a different way of longevity and lived millennia." The Earthwalker is a long-lived Immortal. The Earthwalker Statue depicts a long-bearded and white-haired man holding a cane with kindness in his eyes. One may pray to it and offer incense to avoid illnesses and prolong life.
Desc_110.cn: 《楞严经》：“地行仙，别得生理﹐寿千万岁”，地行仙乃是高寿隐逸之仙人。雕此地行仙像，手执长杖，鹤发长髯，慈眉善目，常常对其敬香祈福，可受福佑，避病延寿。

Desc_111.en: The Bloodmire Orb is blood-red and translucent with a dazzling sheen, capable of absorbing filth from the blood when carried around to replenish and cleanse the body, thus enhancing constitution. It takes in filth to purify the mind and blood and no longer be of use when no longer clear.
Desc_111.cn: 血饥珠赤红如血，清透折光，妖艳夺目。当贴身携带，可时刻吸纳人身污浊血气藏于珠中，人体因此将自发补血净血，从而体质渐强。虽其藏污纳垢，却是以自身净他人心血，当其质地浊污，便再无用处。

Desc_112.en: The Bell Goblet is made from jade essence in the shape of an overturned bell. Taking in too much jade could be harmful for the body, but the goblet has a minimum amount of jade essence, with an opposite effect that adjusts one's Qi and strengthens the body, as long as one drinks from it no more than 1,000 times.
Desc_112.cn: 千钟盏是茶酒之器，形如倒钟，盏口外撇，又称铃铛盏。此盏取玉石髓制成，石髓过量服之本对身体不益，然用此杯化微量入人体，反而可避其害处而调元补气，千杯之内，皆有益体强身之功效。

Desc_113.en: Inspired by the gourd attached to the staff of the Old Man of the South Pole, the deity of longevity, the Immortal Gourd is said to keep away ailments and prolong life. "Those who see it are blessed with peace; those who make offerings may pray for good fortune and longevity." It may be used to pray to the Old Man of the South Pole, not only for good health and longevity, but also for peace across the land.
Desc_113.cn: 仙翁葫芦形象取自寿星南极仙翁杖上葫芦，传言其有驱病延寿之效。“见则天下现安 ，祠之以祈福寿”，通过此葫芦可向仙翁祈福，不止可保自身安稳多寿，更可祈求天下太平长安。

Desc_114.en: Each representing a son of the Great Loong, the nine linked jade locks are not only aesthetically pleasing but also a fun puzzle. If one solves the puzzle, the nine sons of the Loong will bless one with safety, peace, good health, or longevity.
Desc_114.cn: 美玉制成九连环，各环分取龙九子形象，不仅琳琅美观，更可玩之悦之有益身心。相传若能解开此九子琼玉环，则九子显灵，或辟邪、或驱灾、或除病、或延寿，分别赐予吉祥。
Desc_114.ru: Девять связанных между собой замков из Нефрита, каждый из которых олицетворяет сына Великого Лун, не только эстетически приятны, но и представляют собой забавную головоломку. Если кто-то решит головоломку, девять сыновей Луны благословят его безопасностью, миром, крепким Здоровьем или долголетием.

Desc_115.en: The South Pole Emperor of Longevity, also known as the Divine and Pure Heavenly Jade Lord, cares for all beings and dispels disasters and suffering. Carved from a divine stone, the statue of the Pure Lord possesses his power of longevity. Those blessed by it may avoid all suffering and live a peaceful life, and the blessing may even extend to those close to them.
Desc_115.cn: “南极长生大帝，亦号高上神霄玉清王，思念世间，一切众生，三灾八难”，用神石雕成真王像，中藏真王长生力。受此像庇佑者，三灾八难避而除，安康乐生遍身福，其福佑之气更可影响亲近之人，而使众生得乐。

Desc_116.en: The golden statue is carved from a sacred stone into the Heavenly Jade Emperor with a brilliant divine glow, who governs the fates of all lives and commands the Primordial Qi. Touched by the sincerity of those who sculpted the statue, the Venerable Elder bestows Primordial Qi on mortals to prolong their lives.
Desc_116.cn: 以神石塑造昊天玉皇上帝形像，金光闪闪，神光照耀。昊天帝掌管人间吉凶祸福，主自然元气，凡人造此金身，上尊亦感动于诚心，乃将以天地间元气化送凡人，赐福延寿，承天之命。

Desc_117.en: The Oily Orb is dark and shiny with an oily smooth surface. If dropped, it will roll on the ground for a long while, which inspires one to move quickly like the rolling orb.
Desc_117.cn: 乌油珠黑而光润，质感滑腻如油。若不慎失落，便滑于地上骨碌碌滚远，此形象予人启示，有效其法而“脚底抹油”者。
Desc_117.ru: Маслянистый шар темный и блестящий, с маслянисто-гладкой поверхностью. Если его уронить, он будет долго катиться по земле, что побуждает человека двигаться быстро, как катящийся шар.

Desc_118.en: The pair of jade earrings is carved into the shape of cuckoo birds, hence the name Cuckoo Earrings. When it moves, it rings like the chirps of cuckoos urging one to return quickly.
Desc_118.cn: 子规鸟催归，以玉石雕琢成一对子规形象的耳环，名之为子规环。此环一动则响，一声声更切，仿佛在盼人快些回归。
Desc_118.ru: Пара сережек из Нефрита вырезана в форме птиц-кукушек, отсюда и название "Серьги с кукушкой". Когда он движется, он звучит подобно чириканью кукушки, призывающему человека поскорее вернуться.

Desc_119.en: People once thought wild geese could deliver letters to faraway locations as they migrate thousands of miles and then return in spring. This homing nature has inspired this jade figurine of a wild goose, which is used to encourage one to return speedily at opportune moments.
Desc_119.cn: “千里雁传书”，鸿雁归返有期，飞徙千里，从不误时，世人以为其能传书信。玉制千里雁便取此鸟归返飞翔之意，人似感其精神，得知进退有时，方可身轻如飞。

Desc_120.en: The greenish-blue Coldhaze Seal that is cold to the touch is made of jade with white and hazy patterns inside. One may use it to print an embossment on paper of a unique landscape painting as if in a haze or pale moonlight. Those who see it feel refreshed as though they have turned into traceless mist.
Desc_120.cn: 寒烟印色青蓝，质寒冷，内中有白色絮状玉，缥缈不知其所止。凭此物以墨印画于纸上，乃见一幅江水图，月笼寒烟，意境独特，见者不由得心旷神怡，似化为烟雾可作缥缈无踪之行。

Desc_121.en: A vast expanse of emerald water, shimmering under the brilliant sun. As azure as the sky, the Candescent Orb reflects and refracts the sunlight, the glow of which changes constantly despite the orb being held still. The dazzling shimmer seems elusive, near one moment and far the next, and one may learn its elusiveness and move as swiftly as the gleam.
Desc_121.cn: “带天澄迥碧，映日动浮光”，浮光宝珠色如青天，映日则光影浮动，虽宝珠乃静物，光却闪烁不定，因此誉为“浮光宝珠”。浮光灵动之处，倏忽眼前，倏忽身后，倏忽千里，美轮美奂又捉摸不定，人得其理，身姿移动亦得其中妙。

Desc_122.en: The Blue Bird skims above the seas while the Jade Loong hides among the clouds. The Blue Bid is a messenger for the Queen Mother of the West that leads travelers to the celestial mountain of Penglai. Carved in the shape of the Jade Loong and Blue Bird, the pendant grants one the spiritual Qi of the creatures and abilities to freely roam the world.
Desc_122.cn: 青鸟海上游，玉龙云中隐，传说青鸟乃西王母信使，可引客人步路走海至蓬莱。取玉龙、青鸟造型，雕成玉佩，于是似得此二神物之灵气，觉海阔天空莫不能驰往。

Desc_123.en: Xunzi read, "Tengshe grows no feet and flies in the air." It is told that Tengshe, a mystical serpent, has no feet but can ride on mist and fly. Carved from spiritual jade, the translucent and shimmering goblet is used to enjoy liquor under the pale moon, and one may see an illusory serpent soaring from the liquor and into the sky. Those who drink from the goblet learn from the flying Tengshe serpent and become capable of moving with the wind and mist.
Desc_123.cn: 《荀子》：“腾蛇无足而飞”，据记载，腾蛇虽无足，却可驾雾而飞。取灵玉雕成一盏夜光杯，玲珑剔透，光彩熠熠，对月酌酒，酒中有蛇影，忽然杯中起雾，蛇已飞走，似大梦幻一场。然而若饮此杯中酒，便如受腾蛇授法，真有云雾助己行动一般。

Desc_124.en: The orb twinkles from time to time like the opening and closing of an evil eye. Carved from a spiritual stone, it takes in evil spirits and wronged souls and opens when absorbing sinister energy, cleansing it into pure Qi for the holder's use. One may move as swiftly as a ghost with the cleansed Qi.
Desc_124.cn: 宝珠中有光，萤萤烁烁，忽白忽暗，好似妖眼开闭。因由灵石所造，可吸纳天地间邪灵冤魂，每旦收得邪气，妖眼便似张开一线，其中气韵却可化为人用，以气驭力，行动者往往敏捷穿梭，形如鬼魅。

Desc_125.en: Polished from Deus Gemstone, the Divinity Mirror shows a myriad of changing reflections, and only the calm-minded may see their true self in the mirror. From it one may learn that physical changes come from within, which grants them the abilities to transform quickly and flexibly as they please.
Desc_125.cn: 神照石磨平成一方平镜，因石之性，人照之可见千万形表，于镜中时时变幻，心神定者方可从此镜中查得本相。此镜能让人知千万形相可变，千变万化亦从心生发，因此随心之意、照镜之形，则可变换巧动迅如神光。

Desc_126.en: The Extensive Records of the Taiping Era reads, "Ghost blood congeals into agate." The wristlet is made of small agate beads and worn to nourish Qi and ward away evil.
Desc_126.cn: 《太平广记》：“玛瑙，鬼血所化也”，用玛瑙小珠串成的手串，戴于腕上，可养气活血，有辟邪之功。
Desc_126.ru: В обширных записях эпохи Тайпинов говорится: "Кровь призрака застывает в агате". Браслет сделан из маленьких агатовых бусин и надевается для подпитки Ци и защиты от зла.

Desc_127.en: The inexpensive Carmine Ring is translucent with gorgeous red patterns and thus beloved among many. Carmine stones are believed to protect the heart from the invasion of evil, so the ring is often worn by many young commoner ladies.
Desc_127.cn: 绛纹石戒指虽不贵重，但因石上有红色纹理，通透美丽，亦十分受人欢喜。传言绛纹石养人，可护佑心脉不受邪祟所侵，平民女子常常佩戴。
Desc_127.ru: Недорогое карминовое кольцо полупрозрачное с великолепными красными узорами и поэтому любимое многими. Считается, что карминовые камни защищают сердце от вторжения зла, поэтому это кольцо часто носят многие молодые леди из Простолюдинов.

Desc_128.en: Snowlight comes after snowfall and feels cold before warming up. Crafted from jadestones, the round Snowlight Mirror shows vague reflections, while its light slowly warms those in front of it like the sun after the snow.
Desc_128.cn: 霁光乃指雨雪后日光，初觉寒冷，内里却又透出温暖。霁光镜是由玉石打造一整面圆镜，可模糊照见人影，其上玉光便似霁光，人渐渐受此光温暖，内心因而温润。
Desc_128.ru: Снежный свет появляется после снегопада и ощущается холодным до того, как прогреется. Круглое зеркало Snowlight, изготовленное из жадеита, демонстрирует смутные отражения, в то время как его свет медленно согревает тех, кто стоит перед ним, как солнце после снегопада.

Desc_129.en: Upon the Xiangshui River, women shed tears bitter. Xiangfei, the two empresses of Shun wept after his death as proof of their nobility and loyalty. The tear is a condensed jadestone that emotionally affects those who see it like the empresses' tears, while quietly protecting mortal minds and spirits.
Desc_129.cn: “谁知湘水上，流泪独思君”，湘妃二女哭舜帝，乃是其心高洁、其情忠贞之证。以玉石精髓凝成泪珠，观者无不感怀动容，此泪便如同珍视舜帝一般默默庇佑凡人之心魂。

Desc_130.en: The Bejeweled Lute is embedded with a painting made of a myriad of colored jadestone plates linked together. When the lute is played, the jadestone plates resonate harmoniously while the flowers and animals in the painting all seem to be coming to life, soothing the mind and body of those who hear the music.
Desc_130.cn: 以百种异色玉石雕成片，连接成画嵌于琵琶上，方得百宝琵琶。琵琶声起，玉石相震一同和鸣，美妙非凡，琵琶上花卉生物栩栩如生，似随之起舞。于是闻者心神皆醉，得莫大休息。

Desc_131.en: Carved in the shape of Tianlu, the divine auspicious deer, the jade figurine glows brightly in the dark, replacing candles. Bathed in the special light, one will feel refreshed and protected by the divine deer, with the ability to foretell the future, and hence "dispel bad omens and invoke good fortune."
Desc_131.cn: 照夜天禄以玉刻瑞兽天禄之形，可于黑夜中光耀，以代烛火。此光照耀下，用者心清神明，知晓祸福吉凶，受天禄庇护，便致“祓除不祥，永绥百禄”。

Desc_132.en: The sun rises from the Yanggu Valley and bathes in the Xianchi Pond. The Xianchi Pond Jug contains water from the Xianchi Pond because it shimmers brightly in the sun, and the light seems tangible and warm to the touch. Those who hold it will feel the warmth penetrate their skin and into their heart, nurturing their mind and spirit.
Desc_132.cn: “日出于旸谷，浴于咸池”，咸池宝光壶纳咸池之水，壶有辉光如日，盈盈闪动，似触手可握，握之便暖。握者虽掌中无光，但此壶中日暖之意丝丝透过肌肤化入心底、融入内里，蕴养人之心魂。

Desc_133.en: Dim as the moon mantled in filmy clouds; Restless as snow whirled by the driving wind. The Goddess of the River Luo embodies grace and elegance with dark hair as ethereal as the clouds. The comb was once used to brush her hair and left behind in the mortal world. Those who see the relic would become obsessed with the beauty of the Goddess and seek only to protect her.
Desc_133.cn: “髣髴兮若轻云之蔽月，飘飖兮若流风之回雪”，传说洛水之神绝殊离俗，娴静姣媚，其一头乌发如轻云，半遮半掩更显其风姿。洛神梳发所用之篦偶落于人间，见此宝物如见洛神美妙风姿，心中切切，忘言忘餐，只愿一心回护。

Desc_134.en: The Seven Tablets in a Cloudy Satchel reads, "Lady Taizhen is the youngest daughter of the Queen Mother, sixteen or seventeen of age." The jade fan is said to once belong to Taizhen, an Immortal maiden in Penglai, and whoever has the artifact may follow the maiden in and out of the land of Immortals. Since it is from Penglai, it brims with divine energy that makes one feel as carefree as an Immortal as if they had ascended to the celestial realm.
Desc_134.cn: 据《云笈七签》所载：“太真夫人者，王母之小女也，年可十六七”，太真本乃蓬莱仙女，传说其有一只仙玉所制华扃，解开此宝者便可随太真出入蓬莱仙境。因自蓬莱来，自有神仙奇气，得此物者心已至蓬莱，便如神仙般得意忘怀，心无所扰。

Desc_135.en: Originating from an exotic nation, the Croweye Stone is carved with the pattern of a crow's eye to symbolize vigilance and caution, since the crow is believed to always keep a careful watch on its surroundings to react quickly to danger.
Desc_135.cn: 鸦眼石符自外国传入，传言乌鸦可以双目巡视四方，于瞬息之间观测风吹草动。在石上雕刻鸦眼，乃是取其警敏之意。
Desc_135.ru: На камне Croweye, происходящем из экзотической страны, вырезан узор в виде вороньего глаза, символизирующий бдительность и осторожность, поскольку считается, что ворона всегда внимательно следит за своим окружением и быстро реагирует на опасность.

Desc_136.en: Made of polished jadestones, the mirror reflects everything clearly, even the rain splashing on the ground. Those who hold this Rainwater Mirror may accurately sense every movement nearby and spare no doubt when in battle.
Desc_136.cn: 雨花镜是取用玉石打磨而成，照人照物十分明晰，甚至连雨中水花都可清楚映于其上。得此镜者，可以察觉四面八方之动静，从而出手更无疑处。
Desc_136.ru: Сделанное из полированного жадеита, зеркало четко отражает все, даже капли дождя, падающие на землю. Те, у кого в руках это зеркало для дождевой воды, могут точно ощущать каждое движение поблизости и не испытывать сомнений в бою.

Desc_137.en: The poet Tao Yuanming from the Jin Dynasty once wrote about the wild orchid, "Till refreshing breeze comes and liberates its fragrance, it is distinguished from inferior plants." Wild orchids emanate a refreshing fragrance that differentiates them from herbs and weeds. The Orchid Seal has the same fragrance that stimulates the sense of smell so that they may acquire every smell in their surroundings and move accordingly with speed and agility.
Desc_137.cn: 晋时陶渊明曾描述幽兰为“清风脱然至，见别萧艾中”，幽兰但遇清风，便有芬芳，于是可区别于萧艾杂草。幽兰印亦有芬芳，此香可激人嗅觉，更能使人辨识周边气味，五感皆灵，自然更加迅捷。

Desc_138.en: To the clouds a bird of five colors shall belong, singing an ethereal song. Carved from jadestones of five colors, the bird figurine is somehow always half shrouded in mist, as if the divine bird were singing above the clouds. The mist changes with the Qi and dissipates when the Qi fluctuates, while the jade produces a sound like the songs of an immortal bird.
Desc_138.cn: “合有五色禽，叫啸含仙曲”，以五色天然玉石雕成五彩禽，不知为何，常有烟雾自生，笼罩玉上，半遮半掩，五彩禽便如同在云中和鸣仙音。玉上云随气变，于气息变动之时，烟雾陡散，玉竟似真有仙禽鸣叫般发出声响。

Desc_139.en: Alkaid is the easternmost star of the Big Dipper. Instead of creating a cooling breeze, the Alkaid Fan shines brilliantly like a sky full of stars when waved around, and those who hold it will move flexibly with twinkling stars, as if blessed by the powers of the stars.
Desc_139.cn: 瑶光之星，贯月如虹。瑶光扇非是纳凉用，扇之不起风，却于摇动时，流光溢彩，如星辰闪耀，人腾挪转移之间，便见星光闪闪烁烁，似有天星之力助其行事。

Desc_140.en: The prismatic Eventide Orb changes in color with the light varying from crimson to golden, unpredictable like sunlight at dusk. Those who hold it may move as fast as the changing twilight and catch their opponent off guard.
Desc_140.cn: 落霞天珠质有多色，且色随光变，或赤红如血、或金黄耀目，一日之间不见重复，正如“落霞续断”般莫测难定。执此珠者，行动亦常迅如彩霞变换，他人不知其将何为，便见招已先至。
Desc_140.ru: Призматический вечерний шар меняет цвет в зависимости от освещения - от малинового до золотистого, непредсказуемого, как солнечный свет в сумерках. Те, кто владеет им, могут двигаться так же быстро, как изменяющиеся сумерки, и застать своего противника врасплох.

Desc_141.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas reads, "Huashe has the wings of a bird but slithers like a snake, bringing floods wherever it reaches." The jade bracelet is carved in the shape of the Huashe serpent with wings that curl around the arm. It is cold to the touch and adjusts as one bends and outstretches their arm, removing distractions and making the wearer's movements as fluid and aggressive as overflowing rivers.
Desc_141.cn: 《山海经》有载：“化蛇，鸟翼而蛇行，见其邑大水”，以玉雕鸟翼蛇身，绕作缠臂，便为化蛇钏。此器清凉，能随臂之弯曲运动自适其形，又可时常克制约束，化去冗杂之动作，使人快如蛇行，迅猛如大水翻涌。

Desc_142.en: It is almost impossible to paint the mysterious and ever-changing galaxy on paper. But made from a sacred stone, the Galaxia Seal adheres to astronomy and shifts with the movements of the stars above, so it may be used to print the grand galaxy at any moment. Those who hold it will be imparted with the changing way of nature and learn to adjust to different situations.
Desc_142.cn: 天上星河转，玄奥本无穷。世人画山画水难画星河，纵是画得星河，亦不可见斗转星移。星河印需精研星辰运行之奥理，用神石打造成一方活印而成，此印随时而转，时时可印天上须臾之星河。得此物者得妙理，通晓万物之变，随时而转，随势而转。

Desc_143.en: The Commentary of Zuo reads, "The banner of the sun, the moon, and the stars shine in their brilliance." Carved from divine jade, the banner holds all the light in the world. It absorbs radiance from the sun under the clearest sky and the moon and stars on a bright night and glows ever so brightly and dazzlingly. In such brilliance, those connected to the banner will be able to see objects down to the most minute detail and move swiftly with no doubt in their mind.
Desc_143.cn: 语出《春秋左传》：“三辰旂旗，昭其明也”，三辰乃指日月星，以神玉打造成旗状，此旗能纳天之光明。于白日吸纳日之光，于朗夜汇合月星之光，而愈发明亮，耀耀夺目，此光照耀下，与此旗相通者视物清晰无错，心中清明无惑，行止清朗如风。

Desc_144.en: The shiny and solid chess pieces are made of black-and-white agate. Those who use them in chess matches will gradually comprehend the ultimate mystery of Go through calculation and strategizing.
Desc_144.cn: 黑白二色玛瑙制成的棋子，光亮坚实。因棋中妙理无穷，时时对弈一盘，可于筹谋运算中感悟精奥之处。
Desc_144.ru: Блестящие и массивные шахматные фигуры сделаны из черно-белого агата. Те, кто использует их в шахматных матчах, постепенно постигнут высшую тайну расчета и выработки стратегии.

Desc_145.en: The inkstone is waxed and cold to the touch with a sheen like the pale moonlight over the sea. The inkstone is smooth to the touch and edged when ground for ink, popular amongst many, producing fine ink that easily dries when used to paint or write.
Desc_145.cn: 石砚雕海月，以蜡涂于四周，触手微冷，带有光泽，如同海上月清辉。此砚磨墨，抚之如肌，磨之有锋，世人多喜用之，墨质润而易干，书写绘画皆有可用之处。
Desc_145.ru: Чернильный камень восковой и холодный на ощупь, с блеском, похожим на бледный лунный свет над морем. Чернильный камень гладкий на ощупь и с краями, когда его шлифуют для получения чернил, популярен среди многих, благодаря чему получаются тонкие чернила, которые легко высыхают при использовании для рисования или письма.

Desc_146.en: Only a mind of tranquility may rest in true Taoist peace. The translucent and crimson Trance Orb is breathtakingly beautiful with entrancing powers. Those who see it must concentrate their minds to not be distracted, and slowly they will be focused enough to master complex skills with ease.
Desc_146.cn: “惟有摄心坐，憩此真道场”，摄心珠颜色赤红，质地剔透，美丽不可方物，摄人心魄。观者唯有定心坚志才可收敛心神，久而久之，心神更加专一，易使繁复精妙之招。

Desc_147.en: Emperor Shun was once assisted by nine imperial officials who complemented each other. Adorned with jadestones of nine colors, the Nona-Wisdom Lock produces a chime when the jadestones strike each other, as if nine officials were discussing and working out difficult problems together.
Desc_147.cn: 舜帝曾命九官以辅政，济济相让，和而有道。九官琳琅锁乃是以九色不同玉石缀于玉锁而成，玉随锁动，琳琅相击，似九官商讨政事，无论何种难事均可以妙法相解。

Desc_148.en: Made of polished black-and-white jade, the mirror consists of two sides, one of Yin, reflecting the heavens, and one of Yang, reflecting the earth. The Yin Yang Mirror encompasses the entire world of endless mysteries, and those who observe it will slowly learn the truth about the changing world.
Desc_148.cn: 镜由一块天然黑白玉磨成，分为阴阳二面，阴黑阳白。阳面照天，阴面照地，天地之道玄妙无穷，阴阳镜将天地映于一方之内，可在人观照之下展现此中相分相合真理。

Desc_149.en: The Loong-Head Bracelet is engraved with several Loong heads that separate from one another. These Loong heads are movable and may shift on the bracelet when one moves, distracting the enemy. It changes in different situations and makes attacks appear more complex and difficult to counter.
Desc_149.cn: 支离龙首钏上雕数龙首，分散于钏上各处，互不相接，此龙首乃活卯，人动时便各自于钏上移动，令他人眼花缭乱。此物随招式之变，而有繁杂之动，各各不一，以动态使出招看起来更为复杂难解。

Desc_150.en: The Tao Te Ching reads, "This is called the form without a form, the image without an image, like a shadow." Those who possess no form or image are as mysterious and unpredictable as shadow. The seal is constantly changing in shape and sheen, but it doesn't print any patterns when stamped on paper. Those who have the seal will instantly understand the oneness of truth and illusion and break free from all worry, before learning to move not in particular patterns.
Desc_150.cn: 《道德经》：“无状之状无象之象是谓忽恍”，凡物玄虚无形便致玄微难测。无相印形象不定，光泽不定，常随物化形，印上亦无图案，只可得空空如也。得此印者从中顿悟实虚归一之理，心中澄净无所虑，身体行动无定形，却常能以无胜有。

Desc_151.en: The Taishang Laojun used to have a painting of eight trigrams that encompass the world. Even though the Universe Painting is not the Lord's original, it still contains the way of the universe and all the secrets it holds. Those who have it will move in mysterious and unpredictable ways that may only be understood by Immortals.
Desc_151.cn: 乾坤图本是太上老君法宝，刻有乾坤八卦之图案，传说可装载天地。今此物虽非仙人真法宝，亦不可真载天地，但其中确实蕴藏天地之理、玄虚之妙，得者能观情形，自通局势，行动之中含天地八卦之意，非通神者不能解之。

Desc_152.en: Hou Yi once saved the world by shooting the nine suns, from which nine three-legged crows fell, and they swore revenge. The Golden Crow's Eye is made of a sacred stone that absorbed the hatred of the nine crows. Those who have it will be driven by such emotions, moving and attacking suddenly in chaotic ways.
Desc_152.cn: “羿善射，落九乌”，上古时后羿射日以解天下灾祸，日中九只三足乌自天边坠落，愤怒不甘难以瞑目。九乌眼乃神石吸得九乌怨魂自然而成，得者便受此怨气驱使，有如长了三足三目，不可以常理观其行为，却能于刹那得招式齐发。

Desc_153.en: Empress Wu Zetian once ordered all peonies to be burned, but only the branches were scorched whilst the beautiful petals were left intact, as they did not fear the tyranny of the empress. The Singed Twig Ring is made of burned jade in the shape of a withered twig, encouraging one to stand up against strong opponents.
Desc_153.cn: 唐皇武则天曾火烧牡丹，牡丹遇火枝干焦黑，而花却娇媚无损，乃因其不畏女皇强权。焦骨环是用火烧玉石而成，形如枯枝，却铮铮硬骨，更难折断，能予人勇气。

Desc_154.en: Carved from a large red stone, the horn-shaped goblet is smooth, glistening, and as red as wine. It is not only aesthetically pleasing but also a show of power and bravery when one drinks from it, even granting them great strength once the goblet is emptied.
Desc_154.cn: 用大块红石镂空雕琢成牛角形酒觞，光滑晶莹，色如红酒。此杯饮酒，不止赏心悦目，更显人豪爽勇武，酒大口饮尽，力陡生数倍。

Desc_155.en: From the south Zhurong rides the Loong with fire in tow, the blazing banner burns the sky aglow. The Zhurong Insignia is a burning jade token as red as blood with a Loong carved on the surface. Those who hold it will feel a burning urge in the chest, as their blood and Qi flow fasten and their strength builds, as if blessed by the fire-breathing Loong.
Desc_155.cn: “祝融南来鞭火龙，火旗焰焰烧天红”，火龙令乃是一方烫手玉牌，其色赤红，上雕龙形。怀此令者，常感胸怀似受火烧，浑身气血因之涌动，力道也因此大有增长，如受火龙襄助。

Desc_156.en: A thunderclap breaks the stagnancy as Yin and Yang strike. The Yin and Yang Thunderous Orbs vibrate and emit a thunderous sound when striking each other. The sound boosts one's energy, as insects come out of hibernation and prepare for action.
Desc_156.cn: “阴阳分布，震雷出滞”，震雷珠有一阴一阳二珠，相击则相震，并发出雷鸣巨声。因其声响雷动，闻此音者莫不精力大振，更有蛰虫闻声而出，张牙舞爪。
Desc_156.ru: Раскат грома нарушает застой, когда Инь и Ян наносят удар. Громовые шары Инь и Ян вибрируют и издают громоподобный звук, когда ударяются друг о друга. Звук придает человеку Энергии, поскольку насекомые выходят из спячки и готовятся к действию.

Desc_157.en: Gouchen is the deity of violence and war who controls metal in the west. This is a mysterious stone where the light of the north pole shines, and the prowess of Gouchen resides. Those who possess it will be invincible in battle, and it grants even more strength if one's constellation is blessed by Gouchen.
Desc_157.cn: 勾陈禀西方之金，为刚猛之神，好杀，凶恶。以奇石照北极之光，勾陈之凶或可汇入其中，己方得之则勇猛善斗，敌方得之则凶恶骇人，若得流年中有勾陈照命，其效更增。

Desc_158.en: The History of the Southern Dynasties reads, "The earth proves detrimental to your eldest son; suppress it to prolong his life." The large Suppression Seal was created while a mantra was chanted to suppress evil across the country. It not only subdues wicked spirits but also absorbs their power to further enhance the spell, resulting in its ever-growing power.
Desc_158.cn: 《南史》：“地不利长子，若厌伏或可申延”，山河厌伏印乃一方大印，雕印时便念有法咒，可以厌胜之术镇压山河大地中邪祟。既压邪祟，便吸纳邪祟之力，汇自身镇山河之术，使人力中有法，法中有力，威势大涨。

Desc_159.en: Xuanwu, the Black Tortoise of the north with tough scales for armor. The Black Tortoise is one of the Four Symbols with the body of a tortoise and the head of a snake, powerful enough to deter all devils and demons. The cauldron is engraved with the Black Tortoise and five times heavier than an ordinary cauldron, but those who hold it will gain the strength of the Tortoise and not feel the weight, while launching a flurry of attacks at the opponent.
Desc_159.cn: “玄武，谓龟蛇。位在北方，故曰玄。身有鳞甲，故曰武”，玄武龟身蛇头，乃四神兽之一，法力无边，妖邪见之则胆寒。神石鼎上镂刻玄武之相，此鼎更重数倍，因借得玄武之力，举此鼎却不觉重，挥出招而他人胆寒。

Desc_160.en: Huanghu scrapes the sky with divine might; the sword gleams in azure light. The orb is tough enough to resist sharp weapons and harsh environments due to the vajra energy concealed within that may pierce the air and reach the sun. Those who hold the orb can harness the vajra power to make even the clouds tremble.
Desc_160.cn: “黄鹄摩云壮气增，青虹贯斗剑光腾”，此珠质地极坚，刀斧劈不坏，水火侵不进，珠中蕴藏金刚之气，气可通云贯日。有此宝珠者，可以此中凌云壮气驭力而动，其势惊风裂空，有时就连天上云也因此骇动三分。

Desc_161.en: The Almighty Seal does not weigh thousands of kilograms, but it contains enough divine power to lift such weight. Rarely are there people born with the might of Wu Huo, a warrior of great strength in the Qin Dynasty, but with the seal, one will gain such incredible power through the sheer force of one's mind that it can shatter the ground and make the sky tremble in fear.
Desc_161.cn: 千均印亦名千钧印，非指其重达三万斤，乃是其中神力可至千钧。从古至今，世上罕有人有千钧之力，唯乌获等数人而已，但若得此宝印，藏之于身，神力受运动、精神激发，有时通此神力，劲势更比三万斤更重，惊天骇地。

Desc_162.en: The Crystal Bracelet could be in various colors depending on the jadestone materials. It is cold to the touch and as pure and clean as water, capable of cooling the wearer as well as calming the mind.
Desc_162.cn: 水晶镯根据原料玉石有多种颜色，贴肤冰凉，质地皆澄澈如水，毫无杂质，可于丝丝凉意之间使人心静沉。
Desc_162.ru: Хрустальный браслет может быть различных цветов в зависимости от материалов, из которых изготовлен жадеит. Он холодный на ощупь и такой же чистый, как вода, способный охлаждать владельца, а также успокаивать разум.

Desc_163.en: The Seven Tablets in a Cloudy Satchel reads, "The body and Qi are clear with light shining from within and the mind cleansed." The ring-shaped Clarity Pendant is made of clear jade that glows from within and cleanses filth to adjust one's Qi. It is often worn by young women as a show of innocence and rings pleasantly.
Desc_163.cn: 《云笈七签》:“即体澄气真,光明内照,万神朗清”，朗清环佩为一枚环形玉佩，质地清明，内中透光，可吸纳杂污，调理气息，因此心神朗清。常为女子佩戴，可显其冰清玉洁，环佩叮当之声亦十分悦耳。

Desc_164.en: Jadespring is a condensed essence of jade with a pleasant fragrance. It may not only melt in liquor, but also be worn next to the skin so that the pure energy seeps in to cleanse one's body and mind.
Desc_164.cn: 玉泉珏需用玉之精华凝成，芳香甘甜，可以化入酒中服食。然而因其美观，又可以精纯之气化入人身，逐渐荡涤心胸，大有妙用，于是世人常常贴身佩戴。
Desc_164.ru: Jadespring - это концентрированная эссенция Нефрита с приятным ароматом. Его можно не только растворять в Вине, но и носить рядом с кожей, чтобы чистая Энергия просачивалась внутрь и очищала тело и разум.

Desc_165.en: Carved from white jade, the Luminous Candle emits a silver and warm glow without flame. It shines in the dark, and one may read books with its eternal light to further their understanding of the world.
Desc_165.cn: 夜光银烛乃用白玉制成蜡烛形，色银白华美，不燃而亮，其光温润。于夜中照耀，可借此烛光翻书阅物，可伴此长明深思悟道。
Desc_165.ru: Вырезанная из белого Нефрита, светящаяся свеча излучает серебристое и теплое сияние без пламени. Он светит в темноте, и при его вечном свете можно читать книги, углубляя свое понимание мира.

Desc_166.en: To the bell rings in the fragrant breeze, fall to a reverie of bliss. This pair of jade bells dangle on threads of silk and chime when the wind blows, emitting a fragrance that keeps away nightmares from those who hear the bells and makes sure they only have revitalizing dreams.
Desc_166.cn: 风吹花香闻铃响，睡入清梦神自足。入梦铃乃是玉制的一双铃铛，串入丝线，遇风则响，散发芳香。受此声乐花香熏染者，不知为何，再不受恶梦所扰，而只做养神益思之清梦。

Desc_167.en: The square jade chime is engraved with a Loong and intricate patterning. It produces a sound more solemn and graceful than ordinary stone chimes and was once only used by royal families during sacrificial ceremonies. The chimes arouse nostalgic feelings and calms the mind so greater things may be achieved.
Desc_167.cn: 玉石制成中空磬，背面透雕龙纹形，表面只是一方玉磬，细观才知其精美华贵，敲击之声亦比寻常石磬更加清正雅致，旧时只有皇族祭祀才用。此器声透人心神，使人沉静，怀古思今，慎终追远，心中有悟。

Desc_168.en: The blessed land of Langhuang is an expansive realm encompassing secret tomes in each room. The jade pillow was once placed in Langhuan, the bibliotheca of the Heavenly Lord, for him to rest after reading and ponder on the books even in dreams for rare inspiration. It was somehow left behind in the world of mortals, and one might reach enlightenment in their dreams if sleeping on it.
Desc_168.cn: “别是天地，每室各有奇书，琅嬛福地也”，琅嬛乃是天帝藏书之仙境，于福地中观书，困眠则卧，枕以玉枕，梦中亦时刻思索书中真理，常有醒时难得的开悟。此玉枕落入人间，有德者得之枕之，便可从梦中悟道。
