Desc_169.en: Carved with Glacia Jade in the shape of a bowl, the Nostalgia Lamp could emit a flickering but elegant light in the dark. The light is chilly as if not of this earth, and those who hold it might feel empty inside and be rid of all emotions as they achieve enlightenment. If it is held by the weak-minded, they might even see their deceased family and weep endlessly.
Desc_169.cn: 寒玉雕成碗形灯盏，若得青灯盛于其上，暗夜点亮，相映而美。其灯光幽冥，更有寒意伴瑟风阵阵，恍惚不似在人间，只觉心中清冷空寂，七情六欲皆去，神魂得大彻悟。若有心神不定者，有时可于恍惚中见故去亲友，泪流不止。

Desc_170.en: Myriadcore Jade is the essence of all beauty and treasure, its brilliance reaching the mansions of the Ox and Dipper. The jade is a heavenly treasure in the land of immortals that absorbed life forces from the world of mortals. It contains spiritual energy that could reach even the furthest constellations in the galaxy. Those who hold it will learn the history of humanity and understand the ultimate secrets of the universe.
Desc_170.cn: “物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟”，活玉本是仙境宝，取此玉集凡尘生息，得天地造化，便成物华天宝。宝中有奇气，气可通达斗牛二星宿，得此物者，可从中知凡间沧桑之变，通天地阴阳之化，博古通今，无事不通无事不晓。

Desc_171.en: The Lucent Orb is a luminous orb that glows in the dark as it is blessed by heaven and earth. One may absorb the energy within and transform it into Qi.
Desc_171.cn: 夜光珠又称夜明珠，可于暗室生光，乃是因天地造化才得此特性。此光照耀下，其中造化之力亦有些微可化入人之气元。
Desc_171.ru: Светящийся шар - это светящийся шар, который светится в темноте, поскольку он благословлен небом и землей. Человек может поглощать внутреннюю Энергию и преобразовывать ее в Ци.

Desc_172.en: White and as smooth as agar, the jade bowl may be used to hold fruit or drink liquor and tea. If one drinks water from it, the water warms and refreshes one's mind due to the effects of the jade essence.
Desc_172.cn: 凝脂瓯是一只玉制小碗，其色如凝脂，白而温润，可用来盛芳果或饮酒茶。用此器饮水，水亦让人心感温润，不知是瓯之触感，还是水化玉华。
Desc_172.ru: Белую и гладкую, как агар, чашу из Нефрита можно использовать для хранения фруктов или Вина и чая. Если человек пьет воду из него, вода согревает и освежает его разум благодаря воздействию эссенции Нефрита.

Desc_173.en: Once used for sacrificial ceremonies, the jade disk is carved in the shape of the White Tiger. "The White Tiger roars, thunderous across the land before." As one of the Four Symbols, the White Tiger roars to bless the world with good fortune. By praying to the world with the Tiger Jadedisk, one may feel invigorated and courageous as if granted the Tiger's spiritual Qi.
Desc_173.cn: 古时祭祀所用玉器，是以玉雕琢成白虎形象。“白虎晨鸣，雷声于四野”，白虎乃天之四灵之一，鸣则祥瑞，以白虎珪壁向天祝祷，似受白虎之灵气，涨己身之精神。

Desc_174.en: The jade figurines are carved in the shape of the eight drunk Immortals, staggering, drinking with a wine jar, or head lowered... The eight Immortals all seem graceful and vigorous despite being drunk, and those who see it will be inspired and learn their elegant dispositions as if spiritually connected to them.
Desc_174.cn: 以玉雕道家八仙饮酒醉态，或摇摇晃晃、或提酒豪饮、或玉面低垂……名之为醉八仙。此八仙虽显醉态，却依旧仙风道骨，令人神往，人观此物便能感受其意气风发，似与八仙神通有前缘，风骨效仿八仙形。

Desc_175.en: The jade and ivory beads are strung together, and since all beads are white and smooth, it is impossible to differentiate jade from ivory. Those who hold the beads may chant the divine name of the Jade Emperor to move the heavens and increase their innate Primordial Qi.
Desc_175.cn: 用美玉与象牙交替串成念珠，珠皆白润圆正，人不能分辨其中何为美玉、何为象牙。常以念珠持于手中，常念玉帝金号一万遍，则或可打动上苍，固其本质，增先天元气。

Desc_176.en: An ancient mirror was discovered in the Tang Dynasty that is carved with exotic beasts, eight trigrams, and twelve Earthly Branches on the edge. The jade mirror is made to imitate the ancient mirror that can reveal the true appearance of a devil, and if covered in gold dust, it shows one's bones and helps improve one's constitution through frequent practice and training.
Desc_176.cn: 据传唐时曾有人得一面古镜，此镜四方雕异兽，方外设八卦，卦外置十二辰位。今以此形做成一面玉镜，可照妖显形，若涂以金粉，可照见人身骨骼，对镜可察先天之不足，通过后天补足内外，若勤加调养练习，对人大有裨益。

Desc_177.en: The jade orb has absorbed the blood and primordial spirits of the six immortal Taoists, and when combined, the six spirits could unleash a divine power that could change fates and alter one's Root Bone. However, it is harmful for Immortals' Primordial Qi, and abusing it may bring about heavenly tribulation if found out.
Desc_177.cn: 此宝乃是通灵宝玉化入通灵血气而得，珠中纳来六位神仙道人之部分元魂，六魂合一便有神力，可修改天地命数，可改换人之根骨。然而此物对神仙元气有损，若无度使用而导致不慎被察觉，恐遭天谴。

Desc_178.en: The Heptastral Lamp with seven flames has been around since the Shang and Zhou Dynasties. Zhuge Liang in the Three Kingdoms period once lit a lamp with seven flames and claimed that if someone could keep the main flame lit for seven days, their lifespan would be prolonged by twelve years. The lamp is created with secret spells and capable of harnessing the power of Astral Coordination to adjust one's karma and interfere with their fate.
Desc_178.cn: 七星灯自商周时流传，一灯上燃七火，三国时诸葛亮点七星灯，步罡踏斗以禳之，谓七日内主灯不灭，则寿增一纪。此灯用秘门法术，但叫生不由命，死不由天，汇七星调元之力，修人之本质，改前世业力。

Desc_179.en: From the great void, Primordial Qi is generated, marking the beginning of all things and the changing of the five elements. The Primordial Scroll is a depiction of the stars at the beginning of time that also records the details of the world and the cycle of the five elements. If one could decipher the truth in the scroll, all the five heavenly energies - red, yellow, blue, white, and black - will flow from the constellations into their body and grant them all knowledge in the world.
Desc_179.cn: “太虚廖廓，肇基化元，万物资始，五运终天”，太始天元册绘述鸿蒙初生时天星图卷，记述五运六气、生生化化，若能堪破此册中真理，丹天、黅天、苍天、素天、玄天之气均可自上天星宿中化入己身，成道之所生，无有不通。

Desc_180.en: The string of 108 crystal and shiny aqua jade beads is used for Buddhist prayer sessions and turns as one chants the Buddhist scriptures to free the mind from all troubles.
Desc_180.cn: 取用一百零八颗水玉珠串成，晶莹透亮。念咒念佛时取用，珠随经转，渐渐遁去一百零八种烦恼，心便再无旁骛。
Desc_180.ru: Нитка из 108 хрустальных и блестящих бусин из Нефрита цвета морской волны используется для буддийских молитв и поворачивается при повторении буддийских писаний, чтобы освободить ум от всех забот.

Desc_181.en: The string of polished jade prayer beads is proof of good morals and also worn for aesthetic purposes. It protects those who often wear the Buddhist Beads from bad luck and disasters, especially when they have faith.
Desc_181.cn: 玉石打磨而成的佛珠，乃是人有善根之证，因其美观，俗人亦可用之以装饰。常戴玉佛珠，可消灾避祸，人心越诚，佛珠越灵。
Desc_181.ru: Нитка молитвенных четок из полированного Нефрита является доказательством высокой нравственности, а также носится в эстетических целях. Это защищает тех, кто часто носит буддийские четки, от невезения и катастроф, особенно когда у них есть вера.

Desc_182.en: The translucent jade is shaped like the Buddha's hand with a warm and natural presence. Each of these artifacts varies in shape and design, and those who see one will reach a calm state of meditation as if witnessing the Buddha's grace.
Desc_182.cn: 透光佛柄取佛手形，光可透玉，突出其晶莹丰满，变化自然。其形独特，颇堪赏玩，每个透光佛柄造型均不相同，观之如见佛祖拈花，心中禅定。
Desc_182.ru: Полупрозрачный Нефрит по форме напоминает руку Будды, от него исходит тепло и естественность. Каждый из этих артефактов различается по форме и дизайну, и те, кто увидит один из них, достигнут спокойного состояния медитации, как будто становятся свидетелями милости Будды.

Desc_183.en: It bears the pattern of Mountains Seal... Immortals may wear it to pass on power; Taoists may wear it to walk across perilous land, as if blessed and welcomed by all divine spirits. The Mountains Seal is passed down from the Taishang Laojun, and this secret pendant must only be equipped by titled Immortals. Those who wear it may travel across the rivers and mountains without being harassed by any evil or poison.
Desc_183.cn: “此五岳真形图也……诸仙佩之，皆如传章；道士执之，经行山川，百神羣灵，尊奉亲迎”，五岳真形乃是太上老君所传符箓，非有仙名，不可传授，乃仙官之秘。佩此物行山川，一切妖毒皆莫能扰。

Desc_184.en: Unlike other brilliant and bejeweled artifacts, the Dimlit Guardian only emits a faint light from the bottom. Instead of granting good fortune, it focuses on eliminating evil and suppressing demons to ensure the safety of the holder.
Desc_184.cn: 辟邪招财，本应浑身珠光宝气，沉光辟邪却不同，只从底部隐隐透出光来。此沉光辟邪不招财，而专注于除群凶、御妖邪，个性沉静，能予人安心。
Desc_184.ru: В отличие от других блестящих и украшенных драгоценными камнями артефактов, Тусклый страж излучает слабый свет только снизу. Вместо того чтобы даровать удачу, он фокусируется на устранении зла и подавлении демонов, чтобы обеспечить безопасность владельца.

Desc_185.en: Legend has it that the five Loongs of wood, fire, metal, water, and earth left their bones in the barren northern lands before ascension to immortality. The jade pendant is carved in the shape of the five Loong bones and capable of guarding the Primordial Qi in the body. With enough faith, one may even use the pendant to find the buried Loong bones.
Desc_185.cn: 木、火、金、水、土五仙乃五行之神，人面龙身，相传此五龙登仙前将寒骨落于大荒北极。以玉雕五龙龙骨之形，穿绳成佩，可以镇守体内元气，静心固志方可求仙，若其心诚至极，更或许可以凭此玉佩寻得埋龙骨处。

Desc_186.en: The heavens are divided into four directions, each guarded by the Azure Loong, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, and Black Tortoise. Carved from spiritual jade, the buddhist pagoda has the Four Symbols embedded on the four sides on top. One may borrow the divine beasts' power at any moment to deter and suppress the enemy.
Desc_186.cn: 天分四象，青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武分守四方。取灵玉雕佛塔，将四象分别镶嵌于四面塔顶，随地易形，各对方位，乃是动中取定，时刻借神兽之能，力震人神，定人心魂。

Desc_187.en: The Nature's Weiqi Board creates pieces from Yin and Yang energies as the players touch the board to place pieces. Those who have a calm and open mind will be able to stand up against any challenges with calm.
Desc_187.cn: 天地枰乃是一方活棋盘，无须棋子，点而成棋，棋乃分化天地阴阳之气而成。方寸之间，有大胸怀，心中思定，则可视万物为刍狗，敢与天地对峙，亦无任何一丝惊惶失措。
Desc_187.ru: Доска Nature's Weiqi создает фигуры из Энергий Инь и Ян, когда игроки прикасаются к доске, чтобы расставить фигуры. Те, у кого спокойный и непредубежденный ум, смогут спокойно противостоять любым испытаниям.

Desc_188.en: Despite the land unclean, the heart remains serene. Those pure of heart may keep filth away even when they walk among it. Created from Kunlun Oily Jade, the icy and crystal-clear Pure Jade Jug seems to contain endless celestial liquor that seeps through veins and frees one's mind from all troubles, making it as pure and innocent as ice.
Desc_188.cn: “不是居污终不污，谁许冰心一片馀”，人心若怀冰，居污亦出尘。冰心玉壶乃是昆仑活玉所化，寒冷似冰，剔透似冰，此壶中似有无尽仙浆，亦自冷洌，可化入血脉，化入人心，除却心中一切污浊烦恼，于是冰清玉洁变作玲珑剔透心。

Desc_189.en: Engraved with cloud or fish patterns, the pendant is made of crystal and often hung around the neck, wrist, and various implements for decoration. It is a durable and beautiful token of good luck.
Desc_189.cn: 晶石雕成云纹、双鱼等形式，穿之以绳链，可挂在颈上、腕上，亦可用作各类器物的装饰。坚固美观，是吉祥之证。
Desc_189.ru: Кулон изготовлен из хрусталя с гравировкой в виде облаков или рыбок и часто надевается на шею, запястье и различные предметы декора. Это долговечный и красивый знак удачи.

Desc_190.en: The clear and smooth jade Ruyi is shaped like a staff with a claw at the tip and was once used to scratch an itch. It is often carved with the Loong or flowery patterns to symbolize good wishes and gifted to friends and family.
Desc_190.cn: 玉如意形似爪杖，曾为瘙痒工具，别称“不求人”。后常在其上雕刻龙纹、花卉等图案，莹滑剔透，寓意吉祥，又可为作为赠礼。
Desc_190.ru: Прозрачный и гладкий Нефрит Руйи имеет форму Посоха с когтем на конце и когда-то использовался для снятия зуда. На нем часто вырезают Лун или цветочные узоры, символизирующие добрые пожелания, и дарят друзьям и семье.

Desc_191.en: The jade vase is a ritual artifact that is square on the outside with a circular bore and carved with five bats on the four sides and the bottom, which is believed to be a symbol of good fortune. It is often used in sacrificial ceremonies for the earth, as the oracle asks for blessings from the heaven and earth with the help of the bats.
Desc_191.cn: 蝠与福同音，故五蝠亦有五福之意，造一玉琮礼器，外方内圆，分别于侧面四面与底面雕刻五蝠。多用以祭祀土地，巫者通过“天地柱”在的五蝠相助下与天地沟通，请求赐福。

Desc_192.en: Haichan's wise trick for a gold brick. Legend has it that before Haichan became the God of Wealth, he tricked a gold toad into granting him 500 years of cultivation and offering money to help those in need. People often create works of art based on the story, and a statue of Haichan could bless the household with good fortune.
Desc_192.cn: “刘海戏金蟾，步步钓金钱”，传说刘海封财神前，曾戏金蟾，得其五百年修炼金丹，于是蟾吐金钱，周济天下。世人常以此事绘画、剪纸、制玉，若将刘海请回家中摆放，可祈福求财。

Desc_193.en: Marshal Zhao is the martial god of wealth that commands the four Immortals of treasures: Gold Seeker, Treasure Collector, Wealth Finder and Fortune Blesser. People often worship him and pray to his statue for "protection from illnesses and disasters, justice in the judicial system, and good fortune from all deals."
Desc_193.cn: 龙虎玄坛真君赵公明，统帅招宝、纳珍、招财、利市四仙，常为民间所祭祀。对此真君像，可求“除瘟剪虐，保病禳灾，公讼冤抑，买卖求财”，无不如意。

Desc_194.en: The Lotus Sutra reads, "Gold, silver, glaze, clams, agate, pearls, and roses are the seven jewels that make up the divine wreath." It is the amalgamation of great treasures and often worn by Bodhisattvas. Legend has it that inside the jewels is the essence of celestial peaches, which can miraculously heal wounds and stop exsanguination in emergencies.
Desc_194.cn: 《妙法莲华经》记载：“金、银、琉璃、砗磲、玛瑙、真珠、玫瑰七宝合成众华璎珞”，乃世间众宝集成，佛菩萨常身佩璎珞。传言璎珞中盛蒲桃浆，可与万一之时化而外用，治刀伤出血堪称灵通。

Desc_195.en: The jade bracelet is carved in the shape of the thousand Buddhas as they manifest in the current era and blessed by an eminent monk through chanting scriptures. Those who wear it will receive the Buddha's guidance and repel the filth of "suffering, senses, fate, feelings, and troubles" or even transcend life and death if they attain enlightenment.
Desc_195.cn: 以玉雕处贤劫中出世千佛陀之形象，请大德高僧于旁诵经开光，方得此宝镯。得此宝者，将受佛陀引导，排除“劫浊、见浊、命浊、众生浊、烦恼浊”五浊之恶，若能就此窥得佛法，或可超越生死。

Desc_196.en: Seated before a banquet and blooms, to share drinks under the moon. The jade plate has a banquet, trees, and the moon engraved on it and feels cold to the touch. Under the full moon, it reveals a staggeringly beautiful scene of a crowded banquet with blooming flowers, and those who see it will feel as they were attending a feast with Immortals and ascending to the heavens.
Desc_196.cn: “开琼筵以坐花，飞羽觞而醉月”，以活玉制成玉盘，雕以桌筵、花树、闭月，有清冷寒凉之感。若于月下相照，则筵席生彩、繁花盛开、闭月又满，美不胜收，观此景者，如赴天上琼筵，食仙桃仙酿，身欲登仙。

Desc_197.en: Legend says that many once sought after a bowl that brought good fortune to its owner. "A silver hairpin left in the bowl multiplies to fill it to the brim." The treasure bowl is made of Kunlun Oily Jade and filled with precious gems, and even though it doesn't create wealth, those who have it will be blessed with good luck and fortune.
Desc_197.cn: 世有聚宝盆，可纳财招财，传言“偶遗一银钗于盆中，银钗盈满，不可数计”，乃是天下人所求宝物。今以昆仑活玉制成聚宝盆，扑满金玉于其中，华贵非常，虽不可当真以财生财，但得之者好运连连、财源滚滚，似乎确实是此盆之功。

Desc_198.en: The jade pendant is popular among commoners and often hanged on the belt. "A gentleman may never forget his jade pendant." A virtuous man is often compared to jade for its warm and pure nature and integrity.
Desc_198.cn: 以玉石雕成佩饰，悬于腰间，于民间盛行。“君子无故，玉不去身”，君子常与玉比德，以为其温润而泽，气如白虹。
Desc_198.ru: Подвеска из Нефрита популярна среди Простолюдинов и часто вешается на пояс. - Джентльмен никогда не должен забывать свой кулон из Нефрита. Добродетельного человека часто сравнивают с Нефритом за его теплую, чистую натуру и цельность.

Desc_199.en: Pink wings flutter as the butterfly frolics over the wall. The artifact is a butterfly made of jade that is as vivid and graceful as butterflies dancing over blooming flowers. There is a flower that resembles such an item and has inspired many to compose poetry to praise its beauty in lilting tunes.
Desc_199.cn: “粉翅两悠扬，翩翩过短墙”，玉蝴蝶即玉制蝴蝶，栩栩如生，似可恋花飞花，随风飘舞，十分灵动。有花形色似玉蝴蝶，而世人常咏，渐衍变为坊间词调名，委婉悠扬。

Desc_200.en: The green jade amulet is made in the shape of a fancy carp and often used as a keepsake or to command troops. It is a token of both love and imperial power.
Desc_200.cn: 鲤鱼传书，灵动守约，以翠玉制成鲤鱼形信物，常作约定之用，有时也用来调兵遣将。其中既有脉脉含情，又有权杖之力。
Desc_200.ru: Амулет из зеленого Нефрита выполнен в форме причудливого карпа и часто используется в качестве подарка на память или для командования войсками. Это знак как любви, так и императорской власти.

Desc_201.en: The jade figurine is in the shape of an adorable and agile leopard cat. If one keeps a leopard cat, rats wouldn't dare show themselves. It is a fast and nimble creature that leaps and rolls to catch rats, and those who have the figurine may therefore imitate their clever movements.
Desc_201.cn: 人若捕狸猫畜之，鼠皆帖伏不敢出，以玉雕成狸奴形象，灵巧可爱，十分讨喜。因狸猫捕鼠时穿梭翻腾，善用身姿筋骨，恶鼠畏之，因而可从中效仿狸之机敏行为。

Desc_202.en: In a gold jug boils the milk; in a jade cauldron simmer herbs. Taoists cook medicine in a jade cauldron shaped like the glovewort, which emits a faint and refreshing fragrance that also adds a sweet and soothing flavor to the bitter medicine.
Desc_202.cn: “金壶新练乳，玉釜始煎香”，道家唤炊釜为玉釜，用来煎药汁，将玉釜造成铃兰形，煎煮则闻香。其香气清雅，化入药中，令药也去苦增香，使人心旷神怡。
Desc_202.ru: В золотом кувшине кипятится молоко; в котле из Нефрита тушатся Травы. Даосы готовят лекарство в котле из Нефрита в форме перчаточника, который издает слабый освежающий аромат, который также придает горькому лекарству сладкий и успокаивающий привкус.

Desc_203.en: The sun, the moon, and the stars follow set paths. The Illumination Orb contains spiritual Qi from the sun and the moon and shines brightly or faintly depending on the time and place. In its light, one can wisely judge situations and make use of the spiritual Qi inside the orb to reduce their own loss.
Desc_203.cn: “日月有常，星辰有行”，日月珠中有二道日月灵气，循天地常理，因时辰而变，使光辉时而炽烈、时而清冷。人受光辉照耀，便常知时势，就势亦可驭使其中灵气化归己用，善利它物而减少自身损耗。

Desc_204.en: It is difficult to control Feng, the wind, with Primordial Qi, and Shui, the water, with motion and energy, to one's own advantage, but the Fengshui Orb could absorb fengshui energy depending on the location and work with it to replenish one's Qi and force. The orb will be even more effective in places with focused Primordial Qi and flowing water.
Desc_204.cn: 风中有元气，水中有动势，此二物触手可及，却难以运用。而风水混元珠却可因地利形，吸收风水之能，混元为一，补人身之气、势。同时，若某地风聚不散、水行有止，呈风水极好之相，则此宝效用更强。

Desc_205.en: The Udumbara flower is a heavenly flower that grows if Tathagata descends upon the earth. Carved from spiritual jade, the Udumbara flower is snow-white and bone-chilling. Even though not the real sacred flower, it is still blessed by the Buddha's grace and emanates a fragrance that imbues the body with endless spiritual and auspicious energy.
Desc_205.cn: “优昙花乃天花，若如来下生，可感得此花出现”。以灵玉造就优昙花，洁白如雪，冰凉透心，虽非天上真花，亦可感佛陀之大福德力，催发清冷香气，并将佛陀所赠之灵力瑞气源源不断送入人体，使人如有神助。

Desc_206.en: Carved from jade of nine colors blended together, the vase is as ethereal and elegant as the nine Immortal maidens in the heavens. The vase will be filled with the Immortals' tears in the rain, and when the sun shines, the tears will turn into spiritual Qi that watches over its owner and protects them.
Desc_206.cn: 此壶由一整块九色活玉雕成，其色各各不一，相交相融，仙气飘飘，似天上九仙女艳丽华美。若逢天上落雨，壶中便渐渐盛满仙子泪水，等到天气晴好，泪水便化为仙神之灵气，护持在壶主身边，每逢气势之变，便以神力助之。

Desc_207.en: This pair of chopsticks is made of jade and sometimes used for dining in noble households. Unlike wooden chopsticks, they never stain or smell so that one may enjoy the most authentic taste of their food.
Desc_207.cn: 玉石打造的一双筷子，又称玉箸，富贵人家偶尔用此器进食。比之寻常木筷，玉筷不染尘、不沾杂味，让人更能体会食之本味。
Desc_207.ru: Эта пара палочек для еды сделана из Нефрита и иногда используется для приготовления пищи в знатных семьях. В отличие от деревянных палочек для еды, они никогда не пачкаются и не пахнут, так что можно наслаждаться самым аутентичным вкусом приготовленной ими Еды.

Desc_208.en: The mortar is carved in the shape of the adorable Jade Hare on the moon as it is its job to crush and grind herbs. Some believe that the Jade Hare grinds the medicine of immortality, so that the Jade Hare Mortar could enhance the effects of the medicine ground into it.
Desc_208.cn: 传说月宫中玉兔常捣药，因此便有人制药臼而雕成玉兔形象，十分可爱。又有人以为玉兔乃捣制飞升仙药，用此玉兔臼应当能使药效大增。

Desc_209.en: Dew forms in pure light, clear and bright. The cold emerald Purity Jug has a clear and shimmering sheen. With clean water inside, it will often form sparkling dew on the lip. Those who drink from the jug will feel refreshed and revitalized.
Desc_209.cn: “清光凝有露，皓魄爽无烟”，清光壶色青质冷，泛清亮光辉。若壶中存有净水，便常常可见壶边有凝露，晶莹剔透。饮此壶中水，水清凉透脾，人精神大爽。
Desc_209.ru: Роса образуется при чистом свете, прозрачном и ярком. Кувшин холодной изумрудной чистоты обладает прозрачным и мерцающим блеском. При попадании внутрь чистой воды на губах часто образуется искрящаяся роса. Те, кто пьет из кувшина, почувствуют себя отдохнувшими и оживленными.

Desc_210.en: Carved from warm jade, the beautiful maiden has a gentle and warm smile and wears a flowing, elegant gossamer garment. Those who keep it by their side will feel safe and secure as if accompanied by a charming woman, and enemies who see it will be distracted by its beguiling beauty.
Desc_210.cn: 玉罗绮乃是用暖玉雕成一名貌美女子，只见其顾盼含笑，温柔可亲，身着罗衣，衣似飘动。若得此玉罗绮伴身边，则如有温婉女子相依随，常有安心之感，而敌人见之，却只觉妖媚，心受其扰。

Desc_211.en: The transparent goblet made of glaze refracts a prismatic and chilly light. It is often used to hold fruit and liquor under the pale moon, showing an entrancing pattern on the table when moonlight shines through the glass. One couldn't help but ponder and learn to bewitch their opponent.
Desc_211.cn: 此器乃琉璃所制杯盏，透明折光，清冷华美。人常于清夜月下，用之以盛放鲜果美酒，其时月光透过琉璃，于桌上折散成花，景色迷幻如梦，令人不由得生出遥想，而能从中习得摄人心魄之能。

Desc_212.en: A talented man in the Tang Dynasty met an Immortal maiden and eventually married her after grinding medicine for her for a hundred days. The Jadefrost Mirror might have belonged to the Immortal maiden, and was gifted to the young man with the heavenly energy of frost sealed inside to assist him in secret. Some also say that the mirror could show one's loved one instead of a reflection.
Desc_212.cn: 传说唐时有才子巧遇仙女，为其杵玄霜仙药百日，方得娶佳人。玄霜玉镜也许便是仙子曾用玉镜，感于才子诚心，纳玄霜仙气于其中，默默襄助。又有人说对此玉镜，可于其中见到心悦之人。

Desc_213.en: People must drink soup from Meng Po, the deity of oblivion, and cross the River of Forgetfulness to forget their past life and be reborn. But those forgotten memories will be remembered in this Mirror of Forgetfulness, and those who find their mirror might recall their past lives and be overwhelmed by strong emotions.
Desc_213.cn: 人死后要过忘川河，便需饮孟婆汤，待忘却前尘往事，才可转世投生。诸般前尘事，虽人已忘于身后，却被忘川镜记于其中。人若得忘川镜，或可记起前世之事，心中或喜或悲，有遍经沧桑之感喟。

Desc_214.en: Xuanhuang is a jade arc that governs the north in the rites of Zhou. The spiritual jade arc emits five iridescent lights during sacrificial ceremonies, which is the proof of blessings from the god of the north. "From the five lights blow warm breezes from eight sides." The god will send warm winds from all directions and bless one in battles.
Desc_214.cn: 周礼祭祀中，玄璜礼北方。此五色玄璜由通灵仙玉制成，于祭祀之时，能发出五道彩光，明艳非凡，乃是北方神受礼之证。“五光备举，光兴八风”，八方和煦风吹来，可成人之助力，此乃北方神之回报。

Desc_215.en: The jade scroll is a record of divine orders from the Kunlun Mountains, which may only be interpreted by a select few. Those who accept these orders will have heavenly assistance and learn to attack with all the energy between heaven and earth, the force of which is strong enough to crush any ordinary enemy's spirit.
Desc_215.cn: 自昆仑传来的玉册，上书天命，只有合仙缘之人，才可解读其中寓意。天既有命，亦将以天道相助，授之以道，教之以混沌化一之法，于人攻击之时，以天地之气催而向前，常人不可敌其中气力，而心摧魂断。

Desc_216.en: The jade amulet is shaped like a cocoon that is spun and left by an insect for protection as a pupa. Those who hold it would learn to meditate and focus on the mind for invincibility.
Desc_216.cn: 玉质虫蛹形饰品，栩栩如生。因虫于蛹中蓄力，而后化蛹而飞，于是此物可劝人内修其心，便可所向披靡。
Desc_216.ru: Амулет из Нефрита имеет форму кокона, который насекомое прячет и оставляет для защиты в виде куколки. Те, кто владеет им, научились бы медитировать и сосредотачиваться на уме, чтобы стать непобедимыми.

Desc_217.en: The Uncut Jade Orb is a natural round jadestone that is not carved or processed. It is plain-looking with hidden spiritual powers, so people often compare uncut jade to talents that are yet to be discovered.
Desc_217.cn: 璞玉珠乃取天然藏玉之圆石，不经雕琢便成。此石外朴内美，隐有灵力，引人深思，世人亦常用“璞玉”类比未显扬其能的贤才。
Desc_217.ru: Необработанный шар из Нефрита - это натуральный круглый жадеит, который не подвергается резке или обработке. Он невзрачен на вид и обладает скрытой духовной силой, поэтому люди часто сравнивают необработанный Нефрит с талантами, которые еще предстоит раскрыть.

Desc_218.en: The Record of Foreign Matters reads, "Qingfu appears like a long cicada, the Gu of which is like a shrimp roe and always followed by its mother." There is a mythical insect that looks like a cicada in its mature form and shrimp roe in its larval stage. This pair of Qingfu Rings is carved with both forms of the insect, symbolizing companionship that lasts for eternity.
Desc_218.cn: 《异物志》云∶“青蚨形如蝉而长，其子如虾子，得其子则母飞来”，青蚨对戒乃一双玉戒，一只刻青蚨母，如蝉形，一只刻青蚨子，如虾子，寓意相伴相随，不可分离。

Desc_219.en: The jade hook is long and curved with the mythical beast, Chi Loong, carved on the front and a smaller one on the back. It can be worn on the belt around the waist to reduce stagnant Qi in the body.
Desc_219.cn: 此玉带钩长而倒钩，钩身雕以螭龙，形制自适，钩背再琢一小螭，相映而贵。可佩于腰间扣拢腰带，十分舒适，使体内气息少有滞胀。
Desc_219.ru: Длинный изогнутый крючок из Нефрита с изображением мифического зверя Чи Луна, вырезанным спереди, и еще одного, поменьше, на обратной стороне. Его можно носить на поясе вокруг талии, чтобы уменьшить застой Ци в организме.

Desc_220.en: The Enigma Ding is a ritual artifact that holds the answers to mysteries and tells the change of season, while mysteriously changing in shape and color with the time and weather. It holds nothing tangible but the Yin and Yang energy in the world, which will be tempered and then absorbed by one's body.
Desc_220.cn: 通玄玉鼎乃是礼器，可通玄知时，随时气之转移而变形色，十分神妙。鼎中不可盛它物，只有天地间阴阳之气藏于其中，而鼎自为炉，化此二气，炼入人体。

Desc_221.en: Zhuangzi reads, "Chang Hong died in Shu, and his blood turned into jade three years later." The Blood Gourd is filled with blood inside. It prefers absorbing human blood, but in order to devour more, it has to continuously convert it into Qi, which may be used as replenishment for one's body.
Desc_221.cn: 《庄子》：“苌弘死于蜀，藏其血，三年而化为碧”，碧血葫芦颜色靛青，藏血于其内，外见如碧血。此葫芦喜食人血，但因内容极小，只能不断将血化为气，才可纳入新血，此气补入人体，蕴养内质，亦有妙用。

Desc_222.en: Taiji Diagram is a circle with black and white jade that symbolizes Yin and Yang. Some say it is the only token left from ancient times that holds the truth about the way of nature and energy flows, how material essence turns into Qi, spirit, void, harmony, and eventually the Ultimateless. If one could solve the mysteries in the diagram, they may make use of their mind and Qi to the fullest and keep honing their skills through cultivation before eventually achieving immortality.
Desc_222.cn: 太极图乃一方圆盘，以黑白二色玉各成阴阳，有人传说此图乃是远古时遗留下的唯一信物，其中蕴藏炼精化气、炼气化神、炼神还虚、炼虚合道、复归无极之神述真理。当人能堪破其中道理，便可到达气神活用之境界，通过修炼更可不断精进，最终或可登仙。

Desc_223.en: The Purification Vase is a precious artifact of the Immortals that contains Elixir Vajra used to revive the dead. A mortal happened to find such a vase, and even though empty inside, it is still a miraculous object that purifies water and replenishes one's body with heavenly energy, granting them extraordinary powers.
Desc_223.cn: 玉净宝瓶乃是神仙法宝，内存甘露水，水有起死回生之效。凡人偶得此玉净宝瓶，虽无甘露，但宝瓶长久受仙气滋润，自然并非凡俗。储水于其间，则水自清澈，并引瓶中仙气，饮入人体，化入仙界气元，人亦将不同凡俗。

Desc_224.en: The vastness of the four seas never ceases to amaze the world. However, this casket is spacious enough to hold all the sea water and may only be opened by the Revered with mantras. The Oceanic Casket is empty and yet filled with the power of the universe, and if one carries it with them, they will feel an overwhelming and endless flow of Primordial Qi in their body.
Desc_224.cn: 世人尝论四海之浩瀚，无边无际不知其所止，此匣却可纳四海之水，只有天尊可以法咒开启。四海匣内不藏物，本身即有浩瀚之力，若置之于凡人身边，便觉体内元气汹涌翻腾，无力克之，但其无穷无止，化而为用，堪称神通。

Desc_225.en: Forged from Aerosiderite, the ring is in the shape of a sinister Loong with its head beneath its tail, symbolizing the power to dictate life and death. Those who wear it feel powerful enough to slay Loongs, inflicting severe injuries as if clawed by a ferocious Loong.
Desc_225.cn: 玄铁铸成指环，塑降龙形于其上，其形狞恶，龙头在尾下，主生人杀人之权。玄铁引得降龙之气，佩戴者如获生杀之力，但闻破空声阵阵，所划出伤势均有如恶龙所伤，势狰狞而难治。

Desc_226.en: Xuan Chi, an ancient deity of the mountains that was the King of Chu's mount during his expedition to the north. Written in golden ink and made of divine iron, the scroll records the origins of the deity, Xuan Chi, and the way to tame it. Hence, legend says that "Seek Xuan Chi with the scroll to ascend above the clouds and sky."
Desc_226.cn: 玄离又称“玄螭”，乃是古之山神，曾为楚王乘驾北征。此册以金水为墨、神铁为书，记载了山神“玄螭”的由来及驭使法门，故世有“玄册寻螭，登天驾云”之说。

Desc_227.en: Haotian means immense Primordial Qi. Inspired by the celestial artifact possessed by Jade Emperor, the Haotian Pagoda is carved from wood that, even though inferior to the original artifact, may still gather Primordial Qi between the heaven and earth and nourish one's body and mind, with the power to suppress evil beings underneath for eternity.
Desc_227.cn: “元气昊大，则称昊天”，昊天塔本是昊天上帝所持物，今以奇技塑木塔，虽不及本物神通广大，但也可集天地元气于其中，并以此元气蕴养、护持身心，但逢邪祟，便将其镇于塔下，永不可脱逃。

Desc_228.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas reads, "Xihe is the wife of Emperor Jun and the mother of the ten suns." Xihe is the goddess of the sun who gave birth to the ten suns that are the source of all Yang energy across heaven and earth. The Xihe Seal may also generate Yang energy from chaos and the darkest nights, cleansing anything Yin and ominous it encounters and filling its surroundings with a Yang air.
Desc_228.cn: 《山海经》：“羲和者，帝俊之妻，生十日”，羲和乃十日之母，化生天地间一切阳气之源。此羲和印亦可生阳气于混沌，产烈气于暗夜，寒阴晦气遇之则化，凡所过处，阳气渐起。

Desc_229.en: Nüwa created mankind by instilling divine power into clay dolls and granting them the ability to reproduce. The Nüwa Painting is a reimagination of the story, and it is blessed with part of the goddess's divine power that offers one the spiritual energy of life and facilitates rejuvenation if they suffer from rotten flesh.
Desc_229.cn: 娲皇抟土造人，以神力加于土偶，使之获生繁衍。娲皇图绘娲皇造人之景，得些许昔日附土为人之神力，乃能于天地间得“生”之气，而附于人上，若有肉腐坏不生，则以其力催生以灵，而世间难有腐可敌生者。

Desc_230.en: Made of Purpletwist Bamboo, this rare purplish black incense burner emits a spiritual fragrance when incense is burned, appeasing all the sorrow, guilt, and depression in one's mind and releasing the feelings into the air to shield one from agony and pain.
Desc_230.cn: 只有以九曲紫竹为引，方能成此罕有香炉。此炉通身紫黑，质地沉着，焚香其中，香气如有精魂，钻入人心，抚慰心中一切痛楚、哀怜、郁苦，更化入空中，时时护佑人不受郁苦侵袭。

Desc_231.en: To liberate from the causes and effects in the cycle of life and death is the state of nirvana. The Great Nirvana Orb is a relic that has been liberated from the causes and effects and transcended life and death beyond the eighteen dhatus. Those who carry it may attain enlightenment and achieve a calm and worry-free state of mind where there is no suffering or desire and enter the "Ultimate Equanimity."
Desc_231.cn: “轮转生死中，不受诸因缘，是名为涅槃”，涅槃珠本已灭尽因缘，超脱生死，乃是十八界之外宝物。人携之可助于证道，若得入涅槃之境，自此便不必再受风吹雨打、严寒日晒，能够得知清凉寂静，烦恼不现，谓之为“无上清凉”。

Desc_232.en: Tumi, or roseleaf raspberry, once only grew in the heavens. All evil in one's mind will be purged at the sight of this white and delicate flower, as the Buddha believed it to be auspicious. The spirit of the purple bamboo transformed into the flower to seek a clear mind in the world of mortals. "To know the truth of all beings, to dispel evil, to follow nature, and to break free from desire." It frees the mind from the troubles of dreams and illusions.
Desc_232.cn: 荼糜本乃天上花，色白质软，但见此花，恶自除去，佛视之以为吉。紫竹以精魂幻化成此花，于人世间但求一心了然，观花便可“了万法，恶尽除，应物而无情”，于万物看清，不受一切梦幻所扰。

Desc_233.en: To the flow of the banner sound the thunderous beats of the drum. The spiritual banner waves in the wind and with it comes an overwhelming roar of thunder, which motivates those who hear it and grants them indomitable might and the ability to change everything around them in an instant.
Desc_233.cn: “灵旗百万驱雷鼓”，灵物制灵旗，威风凛凛，风翩翩则灵旗动，灵旗动则雷鼓鸣，惊天骇地，势无可挡。人受雷鸣声驱使，藏风云变换之能力，瞬息万变其架势，亦势无可挡。

Desc_234.en: The piece of Cloudlight Clout encompasses all rare and natural phenomena, and once unfolded, it will be enveloped in a rosy, dazzling, and flowing light. Those who carry it will feel unencumbered while moving, as if riding on clouds and could reach any corner of the world.
Desc_234.cn: 万象云光帕包罗万象之珍，本乃仙家法宝，展帕便见云光岚彩，流于周身，光华非凡。行动时只见云光摇晃，身随心动，呼吸云气，自在自行，如同腾云驾雾，只觉天地之大莫有不能至者。

Desc_235.en: Sumeru in a tiny seed; the whole universe in a linen pouch. The Universe Pouch may seem like an ordinary linen pouch with horns, but it in fact contains the ultimate way of creation. It shrinks to the size of a seed when not in use, and expands to hold all things inside without changing its shape. It is even said to be large enough to encompass the universe but mortals cannot unleash its true power.
Desc_235.cn: 芥子纳须弥，叉袋藏乾坤。乾坤叉袋其貌不扬，形如麻袋，上有叉角，却蕴天地间元生万物之理，不用时袋可缩如芥子大小，若盛物便可自然放开，百物容于其间，袋却不显其大。更闻听其可藏纳天地，只是人不能尽其用。

Desc_236.en: The Book of Sui reads, "At the beginning of the world, Pangu parted chaos into the heavens and earth, raising mountains and deepening oceans." The Dawning Orb is made of a divine stone from the dawn of time that is told to have taken in the ultimate power of the ancient emperor, Pangu, which would be activated when polished. It is constantly releasing the overwhelming might and granting those who carry it the strength to defend against an entire army.
Desc_236.cn: 据《隋书》所载：“混沌之初，盘古开天辟地，峻岳夷海”，开天珠乃是取天地之初孕育出的神石制成，传说神石中吸收昔日盘古皇之无上大力，琢磨成珠可激发其中神力。此珠无时不刻不散发其威猛神力，携此物者受宝珠之力影响，有万夫莫开之奇劲。

Desc_237.en: The golden statue is carved from a sacred stone into the Heavenly Jade Emperor with a brilliant divine glow, who governs the fates of all lives and commands the Primordial Qi. Touched by the sincerity of those who sculpted the statue, the Venerable Elder bestows Primordial Qi on mortals to prolong their lives.
Desc_237.cn: 以神石塑造昊天玉皇上帝形像，金光闪闪，神光照耀。昊天帝掌管人间吉凶祸福，主自然元气，凡人造此金身，上尊亦感动于诚心，乃将以天地间元气化送凡人，赐福延寿，承天之命。

Desc_238.en: Polished from Deus Gemstone, the Divinity Mirror shows a myriad of changing reflections, and only the calm-minded may see their true self in the mirror. From it one may learn that physical changes come from within, which grants them the abilities to transform quickly and flexibly as they please.
Desc_238.cn: 神照石磨平成一方平镜，因石之性，人照之可见千万形表，于镜中时时变幻，心神定者方可从此镜中查得本相。此镜能让人知千万形相可变，千变万化亦从心生发，因此随心之意、照镜之形，则可变换巧动迅如神光。

Desc_239.en: The Seven Tablets in a Cloudy Satchel reads, "Lady Taizhen is the youngest daughter of the Queen Mother, sixteen or seventeen of age." The jade fan is said to once belong to Taizhen, an Immortal maiden in Penglai, and whoever has the artifact may follow the maiden in and out of the land of Immortals. Since it is from Penglai, it brims with divine energy that makes one feel as carefree as an Immortal as if they had ascended to the celestial realm.
Desc_239.cn: 据《云笈七签》所载：“太真夫人者，王母之小女也，年可十六七”，太真本乃蓬莱仙女，传说其有一只仙玉所制华扃，解开此宝者便可随太真出入蓬莱仙境。因自蓬莱来，自有神仙奇气，得此物者心已至蓬莱，便如神仙般得意忘怀，心无所扰。

Desc_240.en: The Commentary of Zuo reads, "The banner of the sun, the moon, and the stars shine in their brilliance." Carved from divine jade, the banner holds all the light in the world. It absorbs radiance from the sun under the clearest sky and the moon and stars on a bright night and glows ever so brightly and dazzlingly. In such brilliance, those connected to the banner will be able to see objects down to the most minute detail and move swiftly with no doubt in their mind.
Desc_240.cn: 语出《春秋左传》：“三辰旂旗，昭其明也”，三辰乃指日月星，以神玉打造成旗状，此旗能纳天之光明。于白日吸纳日之光，于朗夜汇合月星之光，而愈发明亮，耀耀夺目，此光照耀下，与此旗相通者视物清晰无错，心中清明无惑，行止清朗如风。

Desc_241.en: Hou Yi once saved the world by shooting the nine suns, from which nine three-legged crows fell, and they swore revenge. The Golden Crow's Eye is made of a sacred stone that absorbed the hatred of the nine crows. Those who have it will be driven by such emotions, moving and attacking suddenly in chaotic ways.
Desc_241.cn: “羿善射，落九乌”，上古时后羿射日以解天下灾祸，日中九只三足乌自天边坠落，愤怒不甘难以瞑目。九乌眼乃神石吸得九乌怨魂自然而成，得者便受此怨气驱使，有如长了三足三目，不可以常理观其行为，却能于刹那得招式齐发。

Desc_242.en: The Almighty Seal does not weigh thousands of kilograms, but it contains enough divine power to lift such weight. Rarely are there people born with the might of Wu Huo, a warrior of great strength in the Qin Dynasty, but with the seal, one will gain such incredible power through the sheer force of one's mind that it can shatter the ground and make the sky tremble in fear.
Desc_242.cn: 千均印亦名千钧印，非指其重达三万斤，乃是其中神力可至千钧。从古至今，世上罕有人有千钧之力，唯乌获等数人而已，但若得此宝印，藏之于身，神力受运动、精神激发，有时通此神力，劲势更比三万斤更重，惊天骇地。

Desc_243.en: Myriadcore Jade is the essence of all beauty and treasure, its brilliance reaching the mansions of the Ox and Dipper. The jade is a heavenly treasure in the land of immortals that absorbed life forces from the world of mortals. It contains spiritual energy that could reach even the furthest constellations in the galaxy. Those who hold it will learn the history of humanity and understand the ultimate secrets of the universe.
Desc_243.cn: “物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟”，活玉本是仙境宝，取此玉集凡尘生息，得天地造化，便成物华天宝。宝中有奇气，气可通达斗牛二星宿，得此物者，可从中知凡间沧桑之变，通天地阴阳之化，博古通今，无事不通无事不晓。

Desc_244.en: From the great void, Primordial Qi is generated, marking the beginning of all things and the changing of the five elements. The Primordial Scroll is a depiction of the stars at the beginning of time that also records the details of the world and the cycle of the five elements. If one could decipher the truth in the scroll, all the five heavenly energies - red, yellow, blue, white, and black - will flow from the constellations into their body and grant them all knowledge in the world.
Desc_244.cn: “太虚廖廓，肇基化元，万物资始，五运终天”，太始天元册绘述鸿蒙初生时天星图卷，记述五运六气、生生化化，若能堪破此册中真理，丹天、黅天、苍天、素天、玄天之气均可自上天星宿中化入己身，成道之所生，无有不通。

Desc_245.en: Despite the land unclean, the heart remains serene. Those pure of heart may keep filth away even when they walk among it. Created from Kunlun Oily Jade, the icy and crystal-clear Pure Jade Jug seems to contain endless celestial liquor that seeps through veins and frees one's mind from all troubles, making it as pure and innocent as ice.
Desc_245.cn: “不是居污终不污，谁许冰心一片馀”，人心若怀冰，居污亦出尘。冰心玉壶乃是昆仑活玉所化，寒冷似冰，剔透似冰，此壶中似有无尽仙浆，亦自冷洌，可化入血脉，化入人心，除却心中一切污浊烦恼，于是冰清玉洁变作玲珑剔透心。

Desc_246.en: Legend says that many once sought after a bowl that brought good fortune to its owner. "A silver hairpin left in the bowl multiplies to fill it to the brim." The treasure bowl is made of Kunlun Oily Jade and filled with precious gems, and even though it doesn't create wealth, those who have it will be blessed with good luck and fortune.
Desc_246.cn: 世有聚宝盆，可纳财招财，传言“偶遗一银钗于盆中，银钗盈满，不可数计”，乃是天下人所求宝物。今以昆仑活玉制成聚宝盆，扑满金玉于其中，华贵非常，虽不可当真以财生财，但得之者好运连连、财源滚滚，似乎确实是此盆之功。

Desc_247.en: Carved from jade of nine colors blended together, the vase is as ethereal and elegant as the nine Immortal maidens in the heavens. The vase will be filled with the Immortals' tears in the rain, and when the sun shines, the tears will turn into spiritual Qi that watches over its owner and protects them.
Desc_247.cn: 此壶由一整块九色活玉雕成，其色各各不一，相交相融，仙气飘飘，似天上九仙女艳丽华美。若逢天上落雨，壶中便渐渐盛满仙子泪水，等到天气晴好，泪水便化为仙神之灵气，护持在壶主身边，每逢气势之变，便以神力助之。

Desc_248.en: The jade scroll is a record of divine orders from the Kunlun Mountains, which may only be interpreted by a select few. Those who accept these orders will have heavenly assistance and learn to attack with all the energy between heaven and earth, the force of which is strong enough to crush any ordinary enemy's spirit.
Desc_248.cn: 自昆仑传来的玉册，上书天命，只有合仙缘之人，才可解读其中寓意。天既有命，亦将以天道相助，授之以道，教之以混沌化一之法，于人攻击之时，以天地之气催而向前，常人不可敌其中气力，而心摧魂断。

Desc_249.en: The vastness of the four seas never ceases to amaze the world. However, this casket is spacious enough to hold all the sea water and may only be opened by the Revered with mantras. The Oceanic Casket is empty and yet filled with the power of the universe, and if one carries it with them, they will feel an overwhelming and endless flow of Primordial Qi in their body.
Desc_249.cn: 世人尝论四海之浩瀚，无边无际不知其所止，此匣却可纳四海之水，只有天尊可以法咒开启。四海匣内不藏物，本身即有浩瀚之力，若置之于凡人身边，便觉体内元气汹涌翻腾，无力克之，但其无穷无止，化而为用，堪称神通。

Desc_250.en: A statue of an Arhat stern of face, mounted on a white deer. It is said that the Deer-riding Arhat once rode a deer into the royal palace, revealed miraculous powers of the Dharma, and converted King Udayana, who thereafter turned to compassion and the Buddha's path.
Desc_250.cn: 一尊神情严肃，身骑白鹿的罗汉像。相传坐鹿罗汉曾骑鹿闯入王宫，展现佛法神通，终于度化优填王，令其从此皈依佛门，心向慈悲……

Desc_251.en: A statue of an Arhat laughing heartily with belly full and dharma implement in hand. It is said that upon hearing the Buddha preach, the Joyful Arhat was filled with delight and attained Arhatship. Ever after, he bore a joyful countenance to dispel the sorrows of all beings.
Desc_251.cn: 一尊挺腹大笑，手握法器的罗汉像。相传欢喜罗汉因听闻佛陀讲法，心生欢喜，终证得阿罗汉果，此后更常常显露欢喜面容，以此化解众生烦恼……

Desc_252.en: A statue of an Arhat lowering his head, holding up an iron alms bowl. It is said he once met a poor woman who offered but a pinch of coarse salt. Accepting it with equanimity, the Alms-bowl Arhat transformed it into treasure, freeing her from poverty.
Desc_252.cn: 一尊单手举钵，垂首无言的罗汉像。相传举钵罗汉曾手持铁钵化缘，偶遇贫妇，得其施舍一撮粗盐，举钵罗汉仍以平等心受供，更令盐化珍宝，助贫妇脱贫……

Desc_253.en: A statue of an Arhat with eyes wide, bearing a pagoda in his palm. It is said he was the Buddha's last disciple. To commemorate his master, he bore the tower aloft, reminding all that the Dharma endures forever.
Desc_253.cn: 一尊手托宝塔，双目圆瞪的罗汉像。相传托塔罗汉乃是佛陀最后一位弟子，为纪念佛陀，方才托塔于掌心，警示世人佛法永存……
Desc_253.ru: Статуя архата с широко раскрытыми глазами, держащего на ладони пагоду. Говорят, что он был последним учеником Будды. В память о своем учителе он поднял башню ввысь, напоминая всем, что Дхарма пребывает вечно.

Desc_254.en: A statue of an Arhat seated cross-legged, eyes shut, unmoving as a mountain. It is said that he was once a mighty warrior who renounced the world to practice. Through deep meditation, he subdued his inner demons and once sat seven days without stirring, even moving thieves to repentance.
Desc_254.cn: 一尊闭目盘坐，不动如山的罗汉像。相传静坐罗汉原为一名力大无穷的武士，出家后便潜心修行，以禅定降伏心魔，曾静坐七日不动，乃至感化盗贼……

Desc_255.en: A statue of an Arhat flying across a river, his robes billowing. It is said that as the Buddha's attendant, he crossed the Ganges to spread the Dharma. When storms arose, he could summon divine power to calm the waves.
Desc_255.cn: 一尊飞身渡江，衣袂自飘的罗汉像。相传过江罗汉本是佛陀的侍者，曾乘船渡恒河弘扬佛法，途中若遇风浪，能大显神通，平息波涛……
Desc_255.ru: Статуя архата, летящего через реку, его одеяние развевается. Говорят, что, будучи слугой Будды, он пересек Ганг, чтобы распространять Дхарму. Когда начинались штормы, он мог призвать божественную силу, чтобы успокоить волны.

Desc_256.en: A statue of an Arhat astride a great elephant, gazing into the distance. It is said he was once the Buddha's elephant tamer, who rode mighty beasts to journey far and wide, guiding beings to cast off worldly frivolity.
Desc_256.cn: 一尊神骑巨象，目视远方的罗汉像。相传骑象罗汉乃是佛陀的驯象师，曾骑巨象，云游四方，教化众生远离轻浮世俗……
Desc_256.ru: Статуя архата верхом на огромном слоне, устремленного вдаль. Говорят, что когда-то он был укротителем слонов Будды, который путешествовал верхом на могучих зверях вдоль и поперек, помогая существам отбросить мирское легкомыслие.

Desc_257.en: A statue of an Arhat joyfully playing with a lion. It is said that the Smiling Lion Arhat was once a hunter in the wilderness. Later, he laid down his blade, took refuge in the Buddha, and in his practice often smiled at wild lions. The lions, moved by his compassion, followed him ever after.
Desc_257.cn: 一尊与狮逗乐，喜笑颜开的罗汉像。相传笑狮罗汉原为山野间一名猎人，后来放下屠刀，皈依佛门，修行时常常对野狮报以微笑，野狮受其感化，竟相随而去……

Desc_258.en: A statue of an Arhat baring his chest, smiling, and pointing to the sky. It is said the Happy Arhat was once a prince of Sindhu. Renouncing worldly life, he became a monk and often revealed his chest to show the Buddha-nature within, declaring, "Buddha-nature is innate, not sought outside."
Desc_258.cn: 一尊敞胸露怀，笑而指天的罗汉像。相传开心罗汉曾为中天竺太子，后来堪破红尘，出家为僧，常常袒露胸膛，以示现心中佛相，只道“佛性本具，不假外求”……

Desc_259.en: A statue of an Arhat sitting sideways on a cliff, stretching his hand downward. It is said the Reaching-hand Arhat once practiced austerities deep in the snowy mountains, often extending his hand to guide the lost and save the suffering, thus earning his name.
Desc_259.cn: 一尊斜坐崖边，手探崖底的罗汉像。相传探手罗汉曾在雪山深处苦修，每每伸手接引迷途者，救苦救难，方得“探手罗汉”之名……

Desc_260.en: A statue of an Arhat resting his chin on his hand, brow furrowed in thought. It is said the Meditative Arhat was the Buddha's own son, who renounced the world in childhood and spent his days contemplating the profundities of Dharma, becoming a model for all practitioners.
Desc_260.cn: 一尊手撑下巴，凝眉沉思的罗汉像。相传沉思罗汉乃是佛陀亲生之子，幼年出家，终日沉思佛法奥义，被视作佛门之中修行者的典范……

Desc_261.en: A statue of an Arhat tilting his head and picking his ear, with a faint smile. It is said the Ear-picking Arhat often performed this gesture to diligently cultivate the faculty of hearing, cleansing the six senses of defilement, and through this practice attained mastery of perfect hearing.
Desc_261.cn: 一尊歪头挖耳，似笑非笑的罗汉像。相传挖耳罗汉常作挖耳状，只为勤修耳根，清除六根尘垢，如此修行，竟终得圆通法门……

Desc_262.en: A statue of an Arhat carrying a cloth bag over his shoulder, grinning broadly. It is said the Cloth-bag Arhat wandered with his sack, and when asked about it, revealed that it held all things and could even contain the afflictions of sentient beings.
Desc_262.cn: 一尊肩扛布袋，咧嘴而笑的罗汉像。相传布袋罗汉常携布袋云游，常人奇而问之，方知此袋包罗万象，更可包容众生烦恼……
Desc_262.ru: Статуя архата, несущего матерчатую сумку через плечо и широко ухмыляющегося. Говорят, что Архат с матерчатым мешком бродил со своим мешком, и когда его спросили о нем, он показал, что в нем содержится все, что угодно, и даже может вместить страдания живых существ.

Desc_263.en: A statue of an Arhat leaning against a banana tree, casually reading a sutra. It is said the Banana-leaf Arhat often meditated in a banana grove until one day he awakened to the truth that "All dharmas are like the banana stalk—hollow within and without substance," and so the people named him the Banana-leaf Arhat.
Desc_263.cn: 一尊身倚芭蕉，闲翻经书的罗汉像。相传芭蕉罗汉常于芭蕉林中坐禅，忽有一日，顿悟“诸法如芭蕉，中空无实”之理，世人便称其为“芭蕉罗汉”……

Desc_264.en: A statue of an Arhat with white brows trailing to the ground, eyes closed in recitation. It is said he endured nine rebirths of austere practice, offering lamps to the Buddha. In his tenth life, for boundless merit, he was born with brows that touched the earth, his wisdom vast as the sea.
Desc_264.cn: 一尊白眉垂地，阖目念佛的罗汉像。相传长眉罗汉历经九世轮回，生世苦修，燃灯供佛，到第十世时，因其无量功德，生来便得双眉垂地，智慧如海……

Desc_265.en: A statue of an Arhat standing with staff in hand, fierce in appearance. It is said that, being slow-witted, he was assigned by the Buddha to guard the gate and sweep the dust. Over time, he swept away the defilements of the mind, attaining enlightenment and Arhatship.
Desc_265.cn: 一尊执棍而立，凶神恶煞的罗汉像。相传看门罗汉因愚钝被佛陀安排守门，持帚扫尘，久而久之竟扫除心垢，得以开悟证果……

Desc_266.en: A statue of an Arhat soaring on clouds, seizing a loong. It is said that while cultivating in Magadha, he encountered a venomous loong that plagued the people. Entering meditation for seven days, he manifested divine powers and subdued the divine loong, who then took refuge and became a Dharma enforcer.
Desc_266.cn: 一尊乘云擒龙，襟袖飘摇的罗汉像。相传降龙罗汉曾在摩揭陀国苦修，恰遇一毒龙盘踞洞穴，毒害百姓，降龙罗汉便入定七日，显化神通，终于降服神龙皈依，化为护法……

Desc_267.en: A statue of an Arhat binding a great tiger, compassion shining in his eyes. It is said that while living in seclusion, he pitied the starving tigers of the forest. Feeding them with his own meals, he gradually transformed their nature, and they became his enforcers of the Dharma.
Desc_267.cn: 一尊力大缚虎，目露慈悲的罗汉像。相传伏虎罗汉昔日隐居山林时，慈悲为怀，不忍见群虎饥饿，便以饭食饲虎，最终感化群虎，为其护法……

Desc_268.en: A worn-out shoe left after the old man in the dreams disappeared.\nThe shoe has seen perils and boredom across the land, but remains sturdier than ordinary footwear. The word "Cultivation" is neither embroidered on its surface nor written in ink, and upon closer observation, it may not even resemble a word, but seems more like patterns in blood and sweat, a formless form, alive yet dead, like the Path of Chan Arts: in meditation cultivate the mind; in justice one remains inclined...
Desc_268.cn: 梦中老僧消失后，留下的残破只履。\n此履不知走过了多少险路，踏过了多少困阻，虽已严重磨蚀，却比寻常鞋履更加坚固，此履内里有一个‘修’字，外侧有一个‘行’字，两字不似刺绣，亦不似笔墨书写，细细观想，便连文字也不像了，倒似血汗浸成的纹路、汇成的心意，有相亦无相，似生还似灭，或许禅武之道，亦复如是：内里修心以待禅机，行善不止仗义扶危……

Desc_269.en: In ancient times, before the world fully took shape, the land was teeming with wild spirits and wandering beasts. Legend has it that if a creature devours rare treasures like flame essence, Centuria Berry, or aqua jade, it can't digest them. Instead, these treasures will condense within its body over time, eventually forming an Eldritch Orb. With this orb, a creature can take human form, and once it does, its lifespan will stretch far beyond 10,000 years. However, such beings are often solitary by nature, slow to develop wisdom, and possess strange yet pure temperaments, making them feared and shunned by the world.
Desc_269.cn: 上古之时，天地尚未开化，世间多有山精野怪。传说，若有精怪吞吃了火精、朱果、水玉等罕贵之物，便无法消解，而会于腹中结丹，久而久之，也就化作了妖仙珠。此珠能使精怪修得人身，而修得人身的精怪，其寿何止万年，只是精怪之属，多独生孤长，加之灵智难启，性情总是十分纯粹而古怪，多为世人所避之。

Desc_270.en: A pair of aged needles, each crafted with different materials and designs, bearing the marks of time.\nThese needles were a parting gift to Feng Qing from her mentors, Xuan Wuyou and Bai Wuyang, when Feng set out on her journey. Forged from the essence of a celestial realm, they are engraved with scenes of flowers blooming at sunrise and wilting beneath the moon—reminders that life and death follow their course, bound by fate. Yet, fate was unkind. Feng Qing met her end in sacrifice, and these once-sacred relics faded into obscurity, lost to the passage of time...
Desc_270.cn: 形制、用材各不相同的二枚针具，其上已经有着岁月侵蚀的痕迹。\n此针乃昔日冯青学成出山时，由玄无忧、白无恙二位前辈所赠，蕴自洞天福灵之地，上有日升花繁与月落花垂之景，乃是要告诫冯青“生死相循，自有天定”，可惜冯青就义，神器蒙尘，逐渐隐没于岁月之中……

Desc_271.en: It is born from the very essence of Zhenwu's being, a force beyond this world.\nQi is the source of all things, flowing into existence and eventually returning to it. However, this Qi lingers, unable to dissipate or merge back into the cycle, for it was never of this world to begin with. When drawn in through breath and meditation, it seems to yearn for a place beyond the heavens, granting the practitioner a sense of transcending reality. But what lies beyond the sky—an Immortal's Mansion or an endless void?
Desc_271.cn: 此炁乃真武肚肠所化，非此世间之物。\n炁乃万物之源，生发万物而终归也要还复于万物，然而此炁却因不能自行流转于此世间，故而凝结不消，聚而不散，盖因此炁并非由此世间生发，便也就不会从此世间消灭。借由此炁吐纳调息，此炁便好似要往天外而去，使得修行之人亦能生出神游天外之感，只是天外之天，究竟是仙府，亦或是空无？

Desc_272.en: Since Pangu cleaved the primal chaos and Nüwa molded humankind from clay, the Cosmic Trinity Essences of Heaven, Earth, and Humanity came into existence. Later, with the arrival of Xiangshu, part of these essences was tainted by its demonic aura, giving rise to evil thoughts that transformed into the Three Demons. The Demonbane Bone was created with the intent of "slaying all fiends and banishing all ghosts, to cleanse the world with unwavering resolve." It was formed from dispersed energies of the Three Demons' Hearts, harboring both the Three Essences and a portion of Xiangshu's demonic aura. These two opposite forces—one pure, one turbid—are locked in eternal counterbalance.
Desc_272.cn: 盘古开辟鸿蒙，女娲抟土造人，天、地、人三才之气由是而生。后因相枢降世，部分三才之气受其魔气所染，以致生出邪念，堕化而成三魔。绝魔骨取“诛尽妖魔百鬼藏，澄清寰宇志不移”之意而成，乃是三魔灵台逸散之气所凝，内蕴三才之气与部分相枢魔气，此清浊二气彼此制衡，交缠不休。

Desc_273.en: This drum of Lion-Face Clan serves as a symbol of unity among the subordinate sects of the Lion-Face Clan, its beats meant to rally members.\nShaped like a Jiegu, it produces a low, deep sound. On its left side, a sleeping lion is painted—the emblem of the Slumbering Lion Hall. On the right, a majestic lion with a flowing mane—the emblem of the Splendid Lion Hall. On the front, a fierce lion baring its fangs and claws—the emblem of the Wild Lion Hall. Each sect left its mark on the drum, but with all the constant infighting, those marks were constantly being wiped clean and reapplied. After so much, they've all blended together into a messy, unrecognizable mix...
Desc_273.cn: 狮相门用以鼓舞门中诸堂，以示诸堂团结的战鼓。\n此鼓形似羯鼓，但声音却更为低沉浑厚，鼓的左侧绘制着一头沉睡的狮子，乃是睡狮堂的标记；右侧绘制着一头锦鬃坐狮，乃是锦狮堂的标记；正中间绘制着一头张牙舞爪的雄狮，乃是狂狮堂的标记。这些标记分别出自狮相门各堂之手，但因诸堂常有争斗，这些标记也就在不断反复地被抹消与被重绘的过程中，变得越来越驳杂不清了……

Desc_274.en: A jade sigil buried beneath the ancient trees of Qinglang Pavilion, engraved with the words "Peace, Patience, Balance, Stillness." It absorbs Spiritual Qi from the world and even True Qi from people, converting it into vitality. This relic was the final gift of the Ghost Valley Master to his three disciples before his passing. Unable to accept their master's fate, the disciples used the sigil to forge a realm among the clouds, siphoning energy from the heavens and mortals alike to sustain his life. In the chaos of Xiangshu and shifting fates, they sought a path for his rebirth, hoping he would return to guide the world. However, as centuries passed, their celestial refuge drifted further from humanity, until the divide became irreversible...
Desc_274.cn: 埋于青琅阁古树下的玉制方印。此印上刻“安、徐、正、静”四字，能够吸收天地灵气甚至人的真气，转为生气。乃是鬼谷先师临终之时传与三位高徒的宝物。三位高徒不甘心先师就此逝世，于是，以此方印铸就云中之境，不断夺取天地、世人之气为鬼谷先师续命，意图于相枢祸世，天亡世人之景中寻觅出路，期待先师重生，能够扶持苍生。只是千年时光荏苒间，仙境离芸芸众生越来越远，直至覆水难收……

Desc_275.en: A fragment of a broken mirror, somehow taken from the Egarim. It's not metal, stone, jade, or anything recognizable. Along its edges, faint engravings tell a story—one scene shows celestial maidens descending from the sky, circling around the Egarim. Another depicts the Egarim changing form, blooming like a lotus. In the next, twelve divine figures draw drops of crimson blood from a blazing sacred furnace and place them into the lotus-like Egarim. And in the last, countless naked figures emerge from within...
Desc_275.cn: 不知如何从一明珏中取出的一片残镜，其质地非金非铁，非石非玉，可看到镜边隐隐刻着许多图画：一幅刻着从天而降的仙女围绕在一明珏四周；一幅刻着一明珏似乎改换了模样，犹如一朵盛开的莲花；又一幅刻着十二个神人，正从一口燃烧着神火的火炉中取出数滴殷红的血液放入如莲花盛开般的一明珏中；还有一幅刻着许多赤身露体之人不断从一明珏中走出……

Desc_276.en: The ultimate masterpiece of the modern skills from Swordsmith Villa, crafted by fusing the indomitable iron that has withstood countless strikes of blades and hammers at the Ancestral Forge. Tempered in searing flames, it has nearly reached an indestructible state, embodying the very spirit of the smith's unwavering will and the essence of creation. Its very presence instills fear in all weapons, causing anything forged with inferior Artisanship, materials, or tempering to shatter upon contact.
Desc_276.cn: 铸剑山庄当代技艺的集大成之作，糅合祖师剑炉中心历经千万次刀劈剑斩、锤棒摧击的顽铁，以熔火锻造而成。已近不灭之质地，恰似匠人之心，造物之本，有令一切兵器惊畏之力，但凡形制、构造、用材、火候有所不足之物，遇之则自行瓦解。

Desc_277.en: A rare and precious ingredient scraped off the inner surface of the Prime Alchemist Ding of the Kongsang Sect, it is condensed dregs left after centuries of medicinal concoctions. It may not be directly digested, but it forms a lasting haze of six colors.\nAccording to the Kongsang Sect, after Qin Shi Huang sent Xu Fu to Mt. Chai and sacrificed thousands of virgins in vain for an concoction that would grant immortality, he gathered the divine iron of the Five Sacred Mountains and ordered the crafting of this Prime Alchemist Ding in the hopes of concocting such an concoction. Unfortunately, Qin Shi Huang died before the Ding even produced a pellet, and it was thus moved to Mt. Kongsang with the alchemists who had lost the emperor's favor...
Desc_277.cn: 自空桑派药王神鼎内刮取出来的罕贵之物，乃是空桑方士千百年来熬炼丹药留下的渣滓凝结而成，虽不能服食敷用，却时时有六种异彩氤氲聚而不散。\n据空桑派所传，始皇帝自从徐福前往柴山牺牲了数千童男童女求取不死仙药却未能成功后，便聚集五岳神铁，命令其余方士铸造了这口药王神鼎，希望以此神鼎自己炼出不死仙药来，可惜，药王神鼎尚未炼出一粒仙丹，始皇帝便已寿终而逝，这口神鼎便也随着做鸟兽散的方士们辗转来到了空桑山中……

Desc_278.en: A skull helm, shaped from shattered bones and held together by dark sorcery.\nIt radiates unrest and impurity, stirring uncontrollable anger and hatred in those who gaze upon it. Few can bear to look directly at it. Yet, for those who can steady their mind and peer deep within, the crown reveals boundless joy—souls cycling through life and death, and the path to enlightenment woven into the fabric of existence. To behold such a dreadful relic is to witness both death and life, for they are one and the same. Without fear, wisdom remains elusive.
Desc_278.cn: 恶魂以法力驱使碎骨塑造而成的骷髅冠。\n此冠饱含烦恼与不净，望之便令人生出愤怒心，仇恨心，不能克制，难以直视。然而，若当真能够守住心神，往骷髅冠深处看去，却又能见无穷福乐，能见魂灵生灭轮转，看到万物成佛的机缘。见此等可怖之物，如见死，亦如见生，正是：生死互因，生死同根，不见恐惧，难寻慧命也。

Desc_279.en: An ancient shamanic grimoire passed down for generations within the Five Immortals Sect. However, rather than detailing venomous hexes, it records the tangled pasts, feuds, and stories between the Miao tribal leaders, sect heads, and Gu Immortals.\nAlthough the grimoire contains no incantations or sigils, reading its tales aloud to Gu elicits strange reactions. Some grow restless, others sluggish; some roll over, while others curl up motionless.\nPerhaps its opening words hold the key: "Gu is the heart of the soul and the emotions of the ghost." Could it be that these creatures feed not on flesh, but on the poison within the human soul?
Desc_279.cn: 五仙教世代秘传的古老巫书，但其中却并无巫蛊之术的描述，反而记载着大量历代苗族首领及五仙教主们，与一些号称“蛊仙”的仙灵们之间的恩怨情仇、过往故事。\n此书中虽无咒语符画，但若节选书中故事轻声向蛊虫诵读，蛊虫却有不同回应：或情绪高昂、或行动迟缓、或翻身打滚、或蜷缩不动。\n或许正如此书开篇所言：“蛊者，心之仙，情之鬼”，蛊虫莫非便是以人心之毒为食的神灵？

Desc_280.en: Malevolence Elder and Benevolence Elder practiced cultivation together in their youth. Above the Demise Abyss, they found a wondrous, naturally formed stone. The two carved into it all the celestial phenomena they observed and the insights into fate they had gained. When the chart was complete, starlight converged within it, and a spiritual aura was born. However, the two eventually had a falling out at this very place. Benevolence Elder fell to the Demise Abyss, and the star chart shattered along with him, its fragments lost in the abyss. Today, only this star chart fragment has been found. Though covered in cracks, its starlight has not faded, and the positions of dozens of constellations still flow within it, reflecting the image of the two of them gazing at the starry river together in years past...
Desc_280.cn: 万恶翁与万善翁早年同道修行，于无生渊上觅得天成奇石。二人将所观星象、所悟命理尽数镌刻于石中，图成之时，星辉内敛，灵韵自生。然二人终于此地决裂，万善翁坠落渊底，星图亦随之崩毁，尽数没入无生渊。如今唯寻得此星图残片，虽裂痕遍布，然星辉未泯，其中数十星宿方位隐现流转，犹映照着昔年二人共观星河之影……

Desc_281.en: When the Vermilion Bird secretly descended to the mortal world, its feathers were scorched by heavenly fire, turning into divine dust gathered by those with keen eyes. Legend has it that the Vermilion Bird, ancestor of all sacred birds, was once punished for pecking at the Heavenly Emperor's Bellflower in the Mystic Garden, causing the flower to fall into the mortal world. However, unable to resist its craving, the bird descended twice more in pursuit of the flower, only to fall both times upon the Chiming Island...
Desc_281.cn: 朱鸟私下人间之时，因羽毛受天火焚烧而化为的仙尘，为有心之人所拾。传说朱鸟为神鸟之祖，曾因啄食天帝玄圃中的帝昭语茯花，致使此花落入人间而受罚，后来，朱鸟抵挡不住口腹之欲，为了再食帝昭语茯花，又两度私下人间，不慎两次皆坠于赤明岛上……

Desc_282.en:
An old iron plate that is carved with small inscriptions in the front,
"Emperor Zhaozong of Tang promoted Taoism, and hence various schools flourished, among which outlaws took advantage of the faithful and brought chaos to the world.
Eleven disciples of the Maoshan Mountain shall leave to slay evil for the greater good..."
Another line of scribbles is carved on the back, "The evil has been slain, but I may never return. I shall be buried with my love in the blood tomb. This iron plate shall be returned to the Maoshan Mountain by my disciple, who has followed me for years, talented but not pure enough of heart. Please take in my disciple, as I may not be able to..."
The last sentence was scratched and changed into "My mentors, I promise I shall find my way back..."
Desc_282.cn:
一块破旧的铁券，正面刻有细细的小字：
昭宗详延道术，天下道门并起，多有邪魔外道鱼目混珠，搅乱阴阳，
今特令茅山门下弟子一十一人出山，诛灭魔首血幽，舍身取义，杀身成仁……
铁券的背后，还刻有另一排凌乱的小字：魔首虽除，难归师门，今大限已至，将同挚爱葬身血冢，此券乃恩师所赐，不敢有失，故托道童送还师门，此童跟随弟子多年，天资甚高，只是心术未纯，望恩师收留照拂，多加管教，不肖弟子绝笔……
最后那句“只是心术未纯，望恩师收留照拂，多加管教”却被狠狠划损，改为了“师父、师娘，我誓要寻你们归来”……

Desc_283.en: Before entering Shaolin, the wordless monk received this bowl for his remarkable capacity.\nThough ancient, it remains flawless and smooth; gaze upon it with a still mind and it becomes a quiet lotus pond, calming a hundred inner demons.\nTradition holds that Bodhidharma, before his passing, entrusted robe and bowl to Huike—"the inner seal for confirming the mind, the outer robe for marking the lineage"—thus beginning the Chan transmission of robe and bowl...
Desc_283.cn: 无字未入少林寺前，曾因天资出众得此祖师之钵。\n此钵虽久经年岁，周身却圆润完满，并无任何缺损之处；倘若静心观之，便似见一方沉静莲池，可消百般心魔。\n相传达摩祖师只履归西之前，曾召诸弟子，听取众人悟境，终将袈裟和钵盂作为正法眼藏的信物传授于二祖慧可。“内传法印，以契证心；外付袈裟，以定宗旨”，如此便为佛门禅宗之“衣钵相传”……

Desc_284.en: It is said that in ancient times, an immortal ape once descended from a mountain peak upon the clouds, transformed into an old man with a weathered face, and presented a jade tablet as a gift, passing on all he had learned in his lifetime to one bound by fate.\nThis object is over a chi in length, carved from a single piece of ancient jade. Though unadorned by any intricate carving, it seems to have gathered the pure radiance of heaven and earth, and the lustre of sun and moon. Its emerald sheen is natural and flawless, bearing an aura of primordial grace...
Desc_284.cn: 相传古时，曾有仙猿自山峰踏云而下，化作苍颜老翁，取玉板相赠，更将毕生所学传授有缘之人。\n此物身长尺余，由整块古玉琢就，不借雕工点缀，却似吸纳天地清辉，日月华光，其碧色莹泽，浑然天成，颇具太古灵秀之态……

Desc_285.en: Its core is of dark wood, its color somber and profound, like a vast, silent emptiness. Its body is of white jade, its luster brilliant and spiritual, like a blazing, pure light. \nThis instrument was crafted from the refined essence of the Dark Owl and White Deer after they, with Taiwu's aid, perfected the law of eight births and eight deaths. It resonates with a long-lasting life force and a deep tranquility, intended to soothe the pain of the wounded and pacify the grievances of the dead. \n"Music heals the heart, balances the blood and qi, lets the spirit flow, and rectifies the mind." All that is born of heaven and earth resonates with rhythm. Using music as medicine, playing this flute can open the five meridians and eight vessels, bridging life and death...
Desc_285.cn: 玄木为骨，其色肃定，有如茫茫空寂，白玉作身，其彩灵耀，好似灼灼鲜光。\n此物乃是玄鸮白鹿经太吾相助，推演八生八死之法得其完备，遂以精气所作。此物生息绵长，宁意悠远，欲为伤者解痛，为逝者平怨。\n“乐以治心，血气以平，通流精神，和正心也。”凡天生地养，无不应律，以乐为药，奏之可通五经八脉，会于死生……

Desc_286.en: When the Little Black Snake shed its form and became human, it plucked a heart-guard scale from its breast and offered it to Taiwu. Smooth as jade, black and white shifting with inner light, it holds the True Qi of Turtle and Snake—yin and yang entwined, soft and firm as one. The Little Black Snake hopes Taiwu keeps it close, to ward off evil and wander the Martial World free from calamity.
Desc_286.cn: 小黑蛇蜕形化人之际，亲手摘下护心鳞片，赠予太吾传人。其质若玉石，色呈黑白，流景内照，鳞中蕴藏龟蛇二将本源真气，阴阳流转，刚柔相生。小黑蛇唯愿太吾传人佩待此鳞，邪祟不近，灾厄难侵；行遍江湖，无灾无疾。

Desc_287.en: The precepts of the Yuanshan Sect, once carved upon a cliff face, have endured the vicissitudes of time. While the characters still gleam with brilliance, the stone carvings have become blurred and indistinct. They seem to depict a great serpent soaring with bared fangs, a crowd of people treading forward with blades in hand, and beasts aiding them in their assault on the serpent. \n"Sincerity is felt within, and its form and qi move the heavens. Bodhi is sought only in the heart; why labor to seek mysteries externally?" Because the stone of this valley was worshiped for a century and witnessed a thousand sincere recitations, it absorbed a ceaseless stream of devotion, imbuing the cliffside sutra with a profound and righteous will...
Desc_287.cn: 曾刻于岩壁之上的元山戒律，饱经岁月沧桑，唯有文字熠熠生辉，石刻却已模糊不清，似有大蛇腾空呲牙，更有人众持刀踏足，隐有群兽助人攻蛇。\n“精诚感于内，形气动于天。菩提只向心觅，何劳向外求玄？”岩谷之石正因曾受百年膜拜，曾历千心诚诵，故得漫漫心意绵绵不绝汇于其中，早令山壁石经之中满蕴正气执念……

Desc_288.en: "Lions burst through dusk-bound cloud, Their arrows cleanse the fiends with fire. They laugh beneath the mast unbowed, No ship from afar dares venture higher." This black-and-gold battle banner bears a flying lion trampling storming waves. Its fierce gaze and outstretched wings command awe, as though subduing a thousand leagues. Wherever it points, and wherever the lions charge, evil breaks and the seas remain forever guarded.
Desc_288.cn: “旗卷飞狮裂暮云，箭穿魑魅靖妖氛。归来笑指桅杆血，异舸岂敢犯南溟？”一面玄底金纹、旗面绣有飞狮踏浪的战旗，其上飞狮怒目振翼，爪下惊涛翻涌，观之凛凛生威，气吞万里。此旗所指，飞狮所向，伏波万里，永镇海疆……

Desc_289.en: This seal was hidden in the Depths of the Heart that Guiguzi created for the Three School Founders. It only appeared in the world when their attachments were completely dispelled and their mindscape opened. Its name, taken from the saying, "The number of the great plan is fifty, of which forty-nine are used," symbolizes that all the myriad things of the world ultimately return to a single origin. In the past, the Land of Immortals was distant and the Taoist heart was veiled in dust; now that the barrier of attachment is broken and the original heart is clear again, one understands that the Great Tao is profoundly simple, contained within one's own self...
Desc_289.cn: 此印藏于鬼谷子为三宗祖师所辟的心境深处，因三宗祖师执念尽散，心境洞开时方得现世。其名取自“大衍之数五十，其用四十有九”，喻包罗万象，终归一元。昔年仙境渺远，道心蒙尘；而今执障既破，初心复明，方知大道至简，原在方寸之间……

Desc_290.en: "In love I give all I may, offering the moonlit gems of Jiangnan."\nThis ancient pair of jade pendants gleams like crescent moons, their shifting light akin to moonshine distilled. Cool to the touch, carrying a faint orchid scent, they stir memories of Mt. Wu clouds and winter peaks.\nThe Celestial Maiden gifted them so that moon and stars may walk beside Taiwu on the road ahead...
Desc_290.cn: 无微情以效爱兮，献江南之明珰。\n一对上古之时制成的古玉珰，莹润皎洁，形似月牙，光辉流转间仿若月华洒落，恰如摘月能而成。此物触之寒凉如水，暗香若幽兰吐芳，漫入襟怀，引巫山洛水之思，夜雪寒山之忆，更教人心神皆醉。\n天女将此物送赠，唯愿如星月相伴，护持太吾前行之路……

Desc_291.en: "Jade water melds five hues, star-light tempers heaven's glow." This jade basin, used by Master Ou when unraveling the mystery of Heaven's Mechanism, is pale-green and translucent, as round as a full moon. When filled with water, five-colored halos flow across its surface, refining any tool placed within—each creation emerging with the quiet radiance of heaven and earth.
Desc_291.cn: “玉水融五色，星晕淬天光“。此玉盆为欧祖破解天枢玄机之谜时，所用至宝，呈青白釉色，莹润剔透，大如满月，可汇聚星斗之光。若水漫玉盆，则有五色光晕流转，用以淬炼器物，所造之物自含天地灵性，冉冉生华。

Desc_292.en: "A glazed medicine bowl, a plate of ivory, a golden ding and jade dagger to mix a divine elixir." Though the bamboo slips are damaged, they remain as verdant as new, exuding a rich medicinal aroma. Yet, they are covered in marks from knives, axes, brushes, and water, though the characters—some in flowing cursive, others in formal seal script—can still be discerned. \nThe writing, fine as silk, covers the slips and seems to move with a life of its own, forming the elixir formulas born from the painstaking efforts of countless alchemists. All their words and trials sought a single goal: immortality...
Desc_292.cn: “琉璃药碗牙作盘，金鼎玉匕合神丹。”竹简虽已残破，仍青翠如新，溢出股股药香，然刀削斧刮，笔涂水擦之痕无所不有，尚能辨出其上文字或笔走龙蛇，或小篆端庄。\n不尽字迹细密如丝，遍布简上，更时时灵动，汇成种种方士呕心沥血所作之丹方，所言所试终求一事，是为长生……

Desc_293.en: A string of fifty wooden beads, each carved with a humanlike face, forming a tantric rosary filled with strange vitality.\nHeavy as stone and uncanny in shape, they seem to show fleeting visions of life and death—three poisons rising, eight sufferings entwining, all passing like smoke. Rubbing them stirs countless drifting spirits, warm and lingering in the palm.\nThis relic once belonged to the Borrowed Robe Monk. Its origins obscure, destined to fall into Taiwu's hands by fate alone.
Desc_293.cn: 以五十颗质地坚硬、貌如人面的木珠串连而成，散发出异样灵性的密宗念珠。\n此物形态诡奇，沉如坚石，握于手中，恍若能见生死百景。一刹间似有三毒扰心，一念中又似有八苦缠身，最后终如过眼云烟，转瞬而过；轻轻摩挲此珠，更觉有万千灵魄，在掌心流转徘徊，温润暖意，久久不散。\n此珠曾为借“衣”僧所藏之古物，来历不明，盖因太吾机缘所至，方能得此异宝……

Desc_294.en: "There were once the maple's trunk, and the maple's heart. From the trunk and the heart was born Mais Bangx Mais Lief—embodiment of the Butterfly Mother, ancestress of the Miao." This ancient silver ornament, shaped like a human-faced butterfly, was crafted in her image. Carried across migrations and war without dulling, its enduring luster mirrors the Miao people's unwavering faith.
Desc_294.cn: “还有枫树干，还有枫树心，树干生妹榜，树心生妹留，古时老妈妈”，妹榜妹留即蝴蝶妈妈之意，是为苗人始祖。蝶母古银便是苗族匠人以古银仿照蝴蝶妈妈所制，状若蝴蝶，生有人面，此物随苗人迁徙千里而不损毫分，历经战乱而银光灼灼，便如苗人信仰始终不灭。

Desc_295.en: Asura King fell to the Emperor of Heaven. His mort warrior Ally descended with a dying star, and was imprisoned in the Demise Abyss for eons. Though rescued by the Taiwu, Aruna's withered soul finally dissipated. In his passing, the star-husk turned to jade and his war-soul to crystal—this relic. Starlight flickers within; in the silent night, one can hear the clash of steel and distant war-cries, as if that ancient battle still echoes deep within the stars...
Desc_295.cn: 昔年阿修罗王与天帝交战，兵败星沉之际，麾下死士阿黎那随一枚寂星共坠凡尘，此后身陷无生渊底不知经年。虽蒙太吾搭救，然身朽魂衰，终归消散。弥留之际，星骸化玉，战魂凝晶，遂成此物。观之可见内里星芒明灭；静夜侧耳，依稀可闻金戈交鸣、战吼嘶鸣之声，恍若那场远古大战，犹在星辰深处回响不绝……

Desc_296.en: It is said the Vermilion Bird of the Four Symbols—essence of fire—rises as sky, settles as earth, its body wreathed in eternal flame.\nThis feather burns red like flowing fire, gleaming with shifting five-colored light as though sun, moon, and stars gather within a single plume.\nBound by deep friendship with Taiwu, the Vermilion Bird offers this treasured feather so that, even at the edge of life and death, Taiwu may ignite purity like sacred flame—burning away corruption and restoring life anew...
Desc_296.cn: 相传四象之朱鸟，火之精也，其气腾而为天，其质降而为地，身覆炽火终生不熄，正是承载浩荡生力的天外神鸟.\n此羽赤红如流火，缀五彩光华，奇色相曜，流辉含英，有如日月星辰之光辉，皆凝于此一羽之中。\n朱鸟与太吾情谊甚笃，故取己身珍爱之羽相赠，盼太吾身陷生死困局之时，仍可如朱鸟之火一般，焚邪净秽，再造生机……

Desc_297.en: One of the burial artifacts made for a princess who died young. Carved from fine jade and assembled from nine separate pieces into a grand pendant, it is adorned with the image of a fenghuang soaring through the nine heavens, intricately engraved with flowing cloud patterns. \n"The fenghuang calls, high on a distant hill. The wutong tree grows, facing the morning sun." However, this jade was ultimately scorched in the fires of war, leaving black-brown burn marks, and was later stained by tomb miasma, imbuing it with mottled crimson specks. Its form and color now resemble a fenghuang weeping blood. \nSuch an exquisite and solemn object is now as light and resilient as bone. To the touch, it is warm and smooth; to hold it is to feel one's own essence stir with an inconsolable sorrow...
Desc_297.cn: 为早夭的王女所制陪葬礼器之一，取美玉而琢，以九璜并组，乃为大佩，纹饰以凤翔九天，镂刻以云纹汤汤。\n“凤凰鸣矣，于彼高冈。梧桐生矣，于彼朝阳”然而此璜究为烽火所焚，烙下黑褐灼痕，终遭墓气所染，浸透赤粉斑驳，其形其状，宛若凤凰泣血。\n如此精美肃穆之物，现今已是轻韧如骨，触之能感其温润如脂，握之则觉精气难平，悲苦攻心……

Desc_298.en: A ring obtained after slaying a Notorious Thief. When worn, it seems to aid in stealing...
Desc_298.cn: 诛杀大盗后所得之戒，佩戴后于窃取时似有神助……
Desc_298.ru: Кольцо, полученное после убийства Известного вора. При ношении оно, по-видимому, помогает в воровстве...

FunctionDesc_298.en: When equipped, increases the final stealing success rate in each stage by 25% (non-stackable), but the ring's durability decreases after each theft...
FunctionDesc_298.cn: 装备该指环进行窃取时，窃取各阶段的成功率可提高25%且不可叠加，但每次窃取后均会降低该指环的耐久度……
FunctionDesc_298.ru: При оснащении увеличивает конечную вероятность успешной кражи на каждом этапе на 25% (не складывается), но Прочность кольца снижается после каждой кражи...
